ca395d166036.curator_note: Friday's edition of the rooftop series you keep coming back to — eight floors over DTLA, sun going down, rotating local house DJs keeping it smooth and skip-free. Free with RSVP, so just walk in early before it caps.
ca395d166036.description: Weekly Friday rooftop house party (5-10pm) at Golden Hour on Level 8 in downtown LA, with rotating local DJs.

a1aee8bcdfae.curator_note: A long-running soulful-electronic night at El Cid for $7 — the kind of low-key, groove-forward room where the selection does the work and nobody's filming. Easy eastside add to a Friday.
a1aee8bcdfae.description: Soulful electronic dance night at El Cid in Silver Lake, doors 10pm, $7.

artist_notes.name: DJ Nuts
artist_notes.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

artist_notes.name: Cut Chemist
artist_notes.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

918a63422186.curator_note: A Mochilla-style 'Like No One Is Watching' digger summit — DJ Nuts and Cut Chemist trading rare grooves with Detroit's Waajeed in the mix. Less peak-time, more for people who care about where the records come from; the Friday move if you'd rather nerd out than rage.
918a63422186.description: Mochilla's 'Like No One Is Watching' all-vinyl global-beats party at 2220 Arts + Archives with DJ Nuts, Waajeed, Cut Chemist and guests; $20.

8d2a98275ab5.curator_note: Vidiots kicks off a Bill Duke weekend with his 1992 LA narco-noir — Laurence Fishburne undercover, Jeff Goldblum sleazy, and an underrated entry in early-'90s Black cinema. Good excuse to finally try the Eagle Rock theater you've been meaning to hit.
8d2a98275ab5.description: Bill Duke's 1992 neo-noir 'Deep Cover' (108 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 7pm, opening a weekend tribute to the director.

artist_notes.name: SHDW
artist_notes.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

2d20ff8e0c2b.curator_note: An all-night-long set from one of modern techno's rhythm specialists, location-TBA-until-two-hours-before like WORK always does it. This is the proper hypnotic-techno end of the weekend — go if you want one DJ taking you the whole way, not the rooftop-groove night.
2d20ff8e0c2b.description: WORK presents German techno DJ SHDW (Mutual Rytm) for an all-night-long set at a location-TBA warehouse in LA, 11pm, tickets from $30.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

0f24a39aa490.curator_note: Bradley Zero headlining a Midnight Lovers open-air day party is about as close to that Sunset Sessions feeling as the weekend gets — sun, disco-leaning house, real selection, no requests. Build Saturday around the 5pm start.
0f24a39aa490.description: Midnight Lovers summer open-air day party at The Bridge with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero plus Masha Mar and LA selectors, from 5pm.

7d0bd069c0e5.curator_note: A sapphic Pride-weekend day party — more community-and-vibes than a billed-DJ night, so it's about the room, not the selection. On the radar if Pride is the priority over the music.
7d0bd069c0e5.description: Sapphic Pride day party 'Hot Girl Summer' at Untamed Spirits, from 3pm, $10.

f44b5d9fe86c.curator_note: Gold Diggers' twice-monthly disco party in East Hollywood — a reliably fun late Saturday for boogie and classic house in an intimate room a short hop from Silver Lake. No headliner billed, but the residents know the format.
f44b5d9fe86c.description: 'The Hustle' first-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

96c73b45a50b.curator_note: A Juneteenth-weekend morning run/wellness gathering at CAAM in Exposition Park — a culture-and-community event, not a music one. Mentioning it for the weekend context, not the lane.
96c73b45a50b.description: Free 'Run The Culture' morning run and community event at the California African American Museum, 9am.

artist_notes.name: Neeko
artist_notes.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

artist_notes.name: Krane
artist_notes.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

cc5a11b4ddb8.curator_note: Sunday Sessions is one of the bigger vinyl-only crews in the country, and this is their open-air Apotheke session — exactly the all-wax, no-laptop house you want closing out a solstice Sunday. Low-key but the real deal.
cc5a11b4ddb8.description: Sunday Sessions LA vinyl-only open-air house session at Apotheke with residents Neeko and Krane, from 6pm.

5dcdfc5a574d.curator_note: Bill Duke was in the cast, which is why Vidiots slots 'Predator' into his weekend — and a 35mm print of the 1987 jungle classic is the right way to see it. Already sold out, so it's a 'if you have a ticket' note.
5dcdfc5a574d.description: John McTiernan's 'Predator' (1987, 107 min) on 35mm at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 3:30pm, as part of the Bill Duke weekend — SOLD OUT.

artist_notes.name: AYYBO
artist_notes.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

artist_notes.name: Ragie Ban
artist_notes.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

6af20e062172.curator_note: The first of a three-night Lake takeover of the park, and the 18+ Friday is the loosest of them — go for the wide-open-field, hands-up version of his sound rather than a tasteful one.
6af20e062172.description: Goldenvoice/Framework present Chris Lake headlining an open-air tech-house party at LA State Historic Park, with AYYBO and Ragie Ban (18+).

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Josh Caffé
artist_notes.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

750cc2565824.curator_note: A location-TBA late one pairing a Detroit lifer with one of the few real vocalists in house — the kind of small, queer-leaning warehouse night that tends to outshine the big rooms this weekend.
750cc2565824.description: Late-night TBA-location house party with Detroit's DJ Minx and London vocalist-DJ Josh Caffé.

artist_notes.name: FARRALONE
artist_notes.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

35bde3a221a0.curator_note: Free-with-RSVP weekly leaning disco and nu-disco — low-stakes and unpretentious, the kind of spot to start a Friday before something bigger rather than make the whole night.
35bde3a221a0.description: Free weekly disco/nu-disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang with residents FARRALONE and Alex D.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer (Dirt Tech Reck, ex-Slum Village camp) — tracked artist; soulful, politically-charged techno and house from the source.

artist_notes.name: Trovarsi
artist_notes.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

artist_notes.name: E.M. Bae
artist_notes.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

artist_notes.name: 92Jelani
artist_notes.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

60356bc699f9.curator_note: A Juneteenth warehouse rave from Black Techno Matters with Waajeed anchoring it — techno reconnected to its Black Detroit roots, which is about the most meaningful way to spend the holiday on a dancefloor.
60356bc699f9.description: Juneteenth warehouse techno party (location TBA) presented by the Black Techno Matters collective, headlined by Detroit's Waajeed.

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

7d3eee612155.curator_note: The strongest night of the Lake run — adding Hot Since 82 gives the open-air a deeper, more European backbone than the Friday, so this is the one to prioritize if you only do one.
7d3eee612155.description: Chris Lake headlines LA State Historic Park with UK house don Hot Since 82 and Club de Combat (Goldenvoice/Framework).

artist_notes.name: Claude VonStroke
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

artist_notes.name: Ardalan
artist_notes.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch and Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Todd Edwards
artist_notes.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

artist_notes.name: Cut Snake
artist_notes.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

artist_notes.name: Falcons
artist_notes.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

367d5cd8ea2a.curator_note: World Cup watch party crossed with a Dirtybird-deep DJ marathon on giant LED screens — a goofy premise on paper, but a genuinely stacked all-day bill that justifies showing up even if you don't care about the football.
367d5cd8ea2a.description: KCRW x Copa Del Rave: an all-day World Cup watch-party-meets-rave at Academy LA with LED match screens and DJs including Claude VonStroke, Todd Edwards, DJ Minx and Ardalan.

artist_notes.name: Ak'chamel, The Giver of Illness
artist_notes.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

artist_notes.name: Derek Monypeny
artist_notes.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

d0dd0d0bf550.curator_note: Not an electronic night at all — this is the heady, masked-ritual psych-folk corner of Zebulon, worth it if you want a left-field listening experience instead of a dancefloor this weekend.
d0dd0d0bf550.description: Experimental psych-folk/drone bill at Zebulon: anonymous Texas duo Ak'chamel, plus Joshua Tree guitarist Derek Monypeny and Kelby Clark.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Rhythm Section International boss out of Peckham — tracked artist; genre-fluid digger (disco, broken beat, deep house) and a touchstone for exactly this rooftop/warehouse-groove taste.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based selector (NTS, dublab; co-founder of Dig Deeper LA) — cosmic disco, tribal and left-field deep house.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

82f9690b2933.curator_note: A 10-hour Bradley Zero session with two of LA's sharpest diggers warming up is the headphones-and-dancing pick of the weekend — build the night around this rather than treating it as a backup.
82f9690b2933.description: Midnight Lovers presents a long-form warehouse party with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero alongside Masha Mar, Xica Soul and Maddy Maia (5pm-3am).

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight and Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic extended sets.

404a1190c380.curator_note: The Sunday/Father's Day cap on the three-night park run — same Lake-and-Hot-Since-82 pairing as Saturday, so pick this only if the weekend night you want is already sold out.
404a1190c380.description: Third date of Chris Lake's LA State Historic Park run with Hot Since 82, an 18+ open-air tech-house party.

artist_notes.name: Cassian
artist_notes.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

artist_notes.name: Kamino
artist_notes.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

2f0dfdae90af.curator_note: Day Trip's daytime melodic-house format in the park, anchored by Cassian — the more emotional, Afterlife-leaning counterweight to the Lake tech-house weekend if peak-time isn't your mood.
2f0dfdae90af.description: Day Trip In The Park daytime melodic/progressive-house party at LA State Historic Park with Cassian, Kamino, Millero and LUMI.

artist_notes.name: Eddie C
artist_notes.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

78348cab1d1a.curator_note: An open-to-close set from Eddie C is exactly the kind of night to plant yourself for — no warmup DJ, no peak-time grandstanding, just one of the slo-mo disco crowd's best diggers building the room all night. Free with RSVP makes it a no-brainer.
78348cab1d1a.description: Eddie C plays an all-night open-to-close set of disco, edits and deep house at Bar Franca.

artist_notes.name: B-Wade
artist_notes.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

4fedbed9168f.curator_note: A recurring soulful-house residency in the back room of Gold Diggers — the warm, vocal, gospel-adjacent end of the spectrum rather than peak-time tools. Good low-key Friday if you want grooves over a big lineup.
4fedbed9168f.description: Recurring all-night soulful-house party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, hosted by resident B-Wade.

bb41161eefe6.curator_note: George Miller's desert-chase masterpiece on the big screen at Vidiots — relentless, practical-stunt insanity that's worth seeing loud and projected rather than at home. Ari's flagged Vidiots as a venue he wants to get into; this is a great excuse.
bb41161eefe6.description: Repertory screening of Mad Max: Fury Road (2015, 121 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock.

artist_notes.name: LYDO
artist_notes.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

artist_notes.name: Frankie Teardrop
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

7aecfa91d404.curator_note: A queer warehouse rave for Pride leaning fast and trance-y — LYDO and Frankie Teardrop are the real-deal underground end of that sound, not a generic circuit party. Skews harder and more peak-time than the rooftop-groove lane, so go in for the energy, not for selection.
7aecfa91d404.description: Location-TBA Pride warehouse party with queer-underground techno from LYDO, Frankie Teardrop, Miracles and J.dB.

artist_notes.name: Tamara Lanza
artist_notes.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

2353e1ad635b.curator_note: The pool-party edition of Sunset Sessions — the rooftop-vinyl-house series at Level 8 that's basically Ari's reference point for a good open-air Saturday. The lineup's local-resident rather than a marquee guest, but the setting and sound are the whole reason to go.
2353e1ad635b.description: Saturday afternoon pool-party edition of the Sunset Sessions rooftop house series at Level 8 DTLA, with Aplex, Tamara Lanza and Electric Field.

artist_notes.name: Antal
artist_notes.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

ec2ca5e297c2.curator_note: We Own The Night marks 15 years of its no-velvet-ropes 'real LA underground rare house' parties by flying Antal in from Amsterdam for an extended set — that's a serious pairing of crowd and selector, and exactly the dirty-disco-into-house energy worth chasing a TBA address for.
ec2ca5e297c2.description: We Own The Night's 15-year anniversary at a TBA downtown location, with an extended set from Rush Hour's Antal flying in from Amsterdam.

artist_notes.name: Reverberation Radio
artist_notes.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

169931f6acf3.curator_note: Not a four-on-the-floor night — this is the Allah-Las' crate-digging crew spinning psych, surf, library and global oddities off vinyl at Zebulon. A great listening-bar-flavored hang if you want grooves and discovery instead of a dancefloor.
169931f6acf3.description: Allah-Las' Reverberation Radio crew DJ a night of vintage psych, surf and global vinyl obscurities at Zebulon in Frogtown.

cbf00da01c90.curator_note: A morning camera-and-coffee meetup for the photo/video crowd — gear talk, coffee and shooting, not a music thing. Off the main lane unless Ari's specifically into the photography-community side.
cbf00da01c90.description: Free morning photography/videographer community meetup (gear + coffee) hosted by Dangycam; address drops after RSVP approval.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

artist_notes.name: john gerrard
artist_notes.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

deede894fa33.curator_note: A free summer-solstice dance at LACMA pairing Richie Hawtin with John Gerrard's 'SPIRITS' artwork — Hawtin in a museum-plaza art context rather than a club, so expect something more textural and hypnotic than a peak-time techno hammer. Worth it for the name and the setting; RSVP required.
deede894fa33.description: Free summer-solstice dance at LACMA with a techno set from Richie Hawtin, tied to artist john gerrard's 'SPIRITS' installation.

artist_notes.name: Dave Harrington
artist_notes.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

artist_notes.name: John Dwyer
artist_notes.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

artist_notes.name: Spencer Zahn
artist_notes.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

artist_notes.name: Aaron Steele
artist_notes.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

artist_notes.name: Tom Dolas
artist_notes.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

e00ad8085b0c.curator_note: A one-off improvising quintet built around Dave Harrington (Darkside) and Oh Sees' John Dwyer at Zebulon — heady, psych-leaning instrumental jamming rather than songs. Squarely in the experimental-band lane Ari wants surfaced, and Zebulon's the perfect room for it.
e00ad8085b0c.description: One-night improvising quintet — Dave Harrington (Darkside), John Dwyer (Oh Sees), Aaron Steele, Spencer Zahn and Tom Dolas — at Zebulon in Frogtown.

artist_notes.name: Yaeji
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017, debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL. A tracked name on a proper North American DJ tour right now.

artist_notes.name: Alima Lee
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

9ea5376be5a4.curator_note: Lights Down Low doing what it does best: TBA location drops day-of, and they've booked Yaeji on a dedicated DJ-set summer tour — whispered-bilingual-house in a warehouse rather than a festival tent is the right format for her. Worth the address chase.
9ea5376be5a4.description: Lights Down Low presents Yaeji DJ set (plus Alima Lee, Hu Dat, AMERICANRECYCLING) at a location-TBA downtown warehouse, 10pm, 21+.

artist_notes.name: Adam Beyer
artist_notes.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno that anchors the darker half of this lineup. Tracked artist.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: Manchester-raised tech-house heavyweight (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s with 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab ('Nightmares'); reliable festival-circuit crowd-mover. Tracked artist.

artist_notes.name: Loco Dice
artist_notes.note: Tunisian-German DJ born Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; evolved from hip-hop residencies to Space/Hi Ibiza residencies; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythm into house and tech house.

artist_notes.name: Hi-Lo
artist_notes.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has dropped on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno pitched between festival and underground.

artist_notes.name: Elderbrook
artist_notes.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' (CamelPhat collab, Grammy-nominated) made him; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act rather than a DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Hayden James
artist_notes.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but a shade more radio-pop.

artist_notes.name: Sidepiece
artist_notes.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house rooted in Motown edits.

artist_notes.name: Westend
artist_notes.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped draft the modern American tech-house blueprint; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

artist_notes.name: Josh Baker
artist_notes.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy, fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project.

artist_notes.name: Riordan
artist_notes.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm, plus Black Book and Catch & Release.

artist_notes.name: Greg 99
artist_notes.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee; Insomniac Records debut.

bb4f346b7a87.curator_note: Day Trip's sixth Long Beach edition at the new Queen Mary Amphitheater is the tech-house festival LA actually needs — the Adam Beyer / Loco Dice / Hi-Lo block gives it real techno weight, and Cloonee headlining keeps it from disappearing up its own prog-house backside. Saturday is the day to go.
bb4f346b7a87.description: Day Trip Festival sixth edition at Queen Mary Waterfront, Long Beach — two-day house/techno/melodic fest with Adam Beyer, Cloonee, Loco Dice, Hi-Lo, Elderbrook, Hayden James, Sidepiece, Westend and 50+ others.

artist_notes.name: Stacey Pullen
artist_notes.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse, ran Blackflag Recordings, and cut the acclaimed DJ-Kicks in 1996. Known aliases: Bango, Kosmik Messenger, Silent Phase. A tracked name bringing genuine Detroit lineage to this TBA night.

artist_notes.name: BAE BAE
artist_notes.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave. Sets move freely through Black diasporic club music: footwork, juke, breaks, R&B; a key figure in LA's queer underground.

artist_notes.name: Nish
artist_notes.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward, soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first curatorial approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

58579f941eb8.curator_note: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO have been landing Berghain-calibre bookings for years, and Stacey Pullen for a TBA late night is exactly that — second-wave Detroit in an intimate warehouse rather than a stage. BAE BAE warming up keeps the energy genuinely interesting rather than just competent.
58579f941eb8.description: Dirty Epic x INCOGNITO present Stacey Pullen (Detroit techno) alongside BAE BAE and Nish at a TBA Los Angeles warehouse, 10pm-4am, $25-30.

artist_notes.name: DJ Toka
artist_notes.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012, now at Exchange LA) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house, and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

3bb8aa27a866.curator_note: Sudamericana has been one of LA's most freewheeling Latin dance parties for over a decade — early 6pm start at Exchange LA, free with RSVP, and DJ Toka knows exactly how to move the room between cumbia, disco, and house without losing the floor.
3bb8aa27a866.description: Sudamericana monthly Latin house/disco party at Exchange LA, DTLA, with resident DJ Toka, 6pm, free with RSVP.

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator, M-Plant founder — co-founder of Underground Resistance alongside Jeff Mills and Mad Mike, then reduced the form to its bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). A tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Disco Zombie
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno sets; hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

artist_notes.name: Ønyx
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ active on the city's underground techno circuit; has an RA profile and plays the same WORK/INCOGNITO-adjacent events — limited wider footprint, included on billing confidence.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio's earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

0f729582faa3.curator_note: Robert Hood in a TBA warehouse on July 4th is the anti-fireworks plan — stripped, relentless M-Plant minimal with a crew of actual LA heads supporting. WORK's format (address drops day-of) means the room stays self-selecting, which is exactly right for this.
0f729582faa3.description: WORK presents Robert Hood (M-Plant, Detroit) with Disco Zombie, Ønyx and Rubbermiro at a TBA Los Angeles warehouse, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Jayda G
artist_notes.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ (Jacinda Gulley) — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul in her selections. Tracked name.

7e00f46a7221.curator_note: Sound is a proper room for Jayda G — she thrives in longer, sweatier sets where she can pull the floor through disco into gospel-house without hitting a hard stop. This is the July 4th pick if warehouse TBAs feel like too much admin.
7e00f46a7221.description: Jayda G (Ninja Tune) headlines Sound Nightclub in Hollywood, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — his stripped drum/bassline formula on 'Minimal Nation' (1994) is the blueprint for a significant chunk of modern techno. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Disco Zombie
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ, dark and groovy underground techno; KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host.

artist_notes.name: Onyx
artist_notes.note: LA underground techno DJ; active on the WORK / Dirty Epic circuit. Limited wider footprint.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ — KCHUNG Radio earlyafters, Dirty Epic / WORK circuit regular. Dark, groovy sets.

241179720c5f.curator_note: Same Robert Hood / Disco Zombie / Ønyx / Rubbermiro lineup as the WORK event — likely a duplicate listing. Confirm before buying tickets; the WORK-branded version (0f729582faa3) is the canonical one to trust.
241179720c5f.description: Robert Hood (M-Plant, Detroit) with Disco Zombie, Onyx and Rubbermiro at a TBA Los Angeles location, 10pm — appears to be the same event as the WORK-presented listing.

e667ba3ea44d.curator_note: LA Discoteca is a recurring night at The Slipper Clutch doing what the name says — disco and house in a basement-y DTLA room. No headliner detail in the billing, so treat it as a low-effort add-on to a Friday that already has Yaeji or Stacey Pullen on it.
e667ba3ea44d.description: LA DISCOTECA recurring disco/house night at The Slipper Clutch, DTLA, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Enayet
artist_notes.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh using deep soundsystem pressure and South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh. Slippery, off-kilter club rhythms.

artist_notes.name: K Wata
artist_notes.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, also a SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; has produced for Yaeji and contributed to the james K remix album. The duo have played as E Wata together.

a2ec0d8dd081.curator_note: CSW (Costumed Suicide Watcher) and SLINK booking Enayet + K Wata all-night is a genuine curatorial swing — SLINK's whole thing is polyrhythmic club mutations that don't resolve neatly into any genre, which makes for unpredictable, genuinely interesting late nights. Different proposition from the Stacey Pullen or Robert Hood options on the same weekend.
a2ec0d8dd081.description: CSW and SLINK present Enayet and K Wata (SLINK, NYC) playing all night at a TBA downtown LA location, 10pm, live/DJ.

artist_notes.name: discostan
artist_notes.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South and West Asian / North African music: 1980s disco, folkloric sounds, dancefloor re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW. One of a kind in LA.

da4e3fe70e19.curator_note: Discostan at El Cid is one of LA's genuinely singular recurring nights — Arshia Haq and crew weave SWANA folkloric music, '80s diaspora disco and re-edits into something no other promoter is doing in the city. Different enough from the house/techno lane to feel like a real discovery rather than a lateral move.
da4e3fe70e19.description: Discostan at El Cid, Silver Lake — the LA SWANA diaspora dance collective (Arshia Haq, co-founder) playing South/West Asian and North African disco, re-edits and folkloric dancefloor music, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: Pocari G
artist_notes.note: LA-based house DJ — active in the local underground circuit; limited wider public footprint, name included on billing confidence.

artist_notes.name: Ashtre
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found.

artist_notes.name: Costa
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

artist_notes.name: Oso Disco
artist_notes.note: LA DJ name — local disco/house selector; included per billing.

artist_notes.name: Blaze Claze
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ; included per billing, no wider verifiable profile found.

4d5f11e375f5.curator_note: Butterground is a local DTLA house collective running TBA-location parties — all local selectors, no marquee name, but that format at 9pm on July 4th usually means an early crowd that's actually there to dance rather than pose. Worth watching if you're already out that night.
4d5f11e375f5.description: Butterground house collective party at a TBA DTLA location with Pocari G, Ashtre, Costa, Oso Disco and Blaze Claze, 9pm.

a686cbd059dc.curator_note: INLAND GROOVE running a 2am afterhours on July 4th in DTLA — no lineup detail, which is how these things go. If you're already at Robert Hood or Jayda G and want to keep moving, this is the move; if you're picking cold, wait for the lineup drop.
a686cbd059dc.description: INLAND GROOVE afterhours party at a DTLA location, starting 2am on July 4th — lineup TBA.

artist_notes.name: Halo Varga
artist_notes.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owns Artifact Record Shop. House and techno with deep Chicago roots and a European finish.

artist_notes.name: Dylan Payne
artist_notes.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — soul-forward, all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

artist_notes.name: Highkin'
artist_notes.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

4b5718ac6609.curator_note: MARBLE runs proper Arts District afterhours — a 10pm-to-7am window with Halo Varga, one of fabric's original residents, at the top of the bill. The fabric lineage plus Dylan Payne's vinyl microhouse is the right combination for anyone who wants to go deep rather than wide tonight.
4b5718ac6609.description: MARBLE afterhours at a TBA Arts District location with Halo Varga (fabric/All Inn), Dylan Payne, Hazy, PabloDiscobar and more, 10pm-7am, $20-37.

artist_notes.name: Flying Mojito Bros
artist_notes.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda. Genuinely odd and fun in the right way.

artist_notes.name: Brainstory
artist_notes.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; live band performing at this Camille's date, not a DJ set. A bit outside the pure dance lane but with real groove DNA.

fd9f6e2edd10.curator_note: Flying Mojito Bros are a left-field booking for Camille's — their cosmic country-funk-to-acid-house sets are genuinely weird and don't fit a clean genre box, which tends to make for memorable nights. Brainstory are a live band so this is a hybrid show/club format; go for the FMB set if you want to dance.
fd9f6e2edd10.description: Flying Mojito Bros (cosmic disco/acid house, UK) and live soul-jazz act Brainstory at Camille's at The Bellwether, 9pm-2am, $24.

c272d34d687c.curator_note: Inland Groove's Saturday-night afterhours edition — free before 1am with RSVP, $10 after, runs to 5am. No lineup announced yet; check closer to the night. The brand has a consistent house-focused sound and the same TBA-DTLA format as their July 4 edition.
c272d34d687c.description: Inland Groove afterhours at a TBA DTLA location, Sat June 27, 11pm-5am — free with RSVP before 1am, $10 after.

f4fe507771f1.curator_note: Gold Diggers' Groove Room is a no-frills house party in a small East Hollywood room — the name says it, house and hits on a Friday night with no headliner. The kind of unpretentious local spot worth walking to from Silver Lake if you want to dance without a ticket line.
f4fe507771f1.description: Groove Room recurring house and dancefloor-hits party at Gold Diggers, East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Ginger Root
artist_notes.note: Cameron Lew's solo project out of Huntington Beach — indie soul/alt-disco/boogie and Japanese city pop influences; his recordings are meticulously crafted handmade synth-pop. This is a DJ set appearance, not a live band show — expect disco, boogie, and city-pop records rather than his own material.

cf65e6d3a51e.curator_note: Ginger Root doing a DJ set at Camille's is a fun oddity — his music sits in the boogie/alt-disco zone and a free DJ night lets him play his influences rather than perform. Low commitment, free entry, and a nice change of pace from the heavier club nights on the same night.
cf65e6d3a51e.description: Ginger Root (Cameron Lew, indie soul/alt-disco) plays a free DJ set at Camille's at The Bellwether, 8pm-2am.

d26b1c2aec3d.curator_note: The Hustle on July 4th is the same format as every first-and-third Saturday — Gold Diggers' reliable disco-and-boogie residency, no headliner, just the residents doing their thing in a small East Hollywood room. Easy late add to a Fourth if the warehouse TBAs don't pan out.
d26b1c2aec3d.description: The Hustle recurring first-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers, East Hollywood, July 4, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Eli Escobar
artist_notes.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco and jazzy house through funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor. A proper New York DJ with the range to go long.

9412d5b2209e.curator_note: Midnight Lovers booking Eli Escobar for a TBA July 4th date is a solid pull — he's one of New York's most versatile selectors, the kind of DJ who can stretch a set from disco to cumbia and keep everyone dancing. The TBA format means the room will be self-selecting, which is exactly right for this.
9412d5b2209e.description: Midnight Lovers presents Eli Escobar (Night People NYC, Tiki Disco) at a TBA DTLA location, July 4, 7pm-2am, $22 advance.

artist_notes.name: Vendex
artist_notes.note: Barcelona-born dark/industrial/acid hard-techno DJ and producer — releases on Soma Records, Occult Rhythms, Critical Revolution among others; plays Rotterdam Rave and Verknipt circuit. Not the groove/selector lane; this is peak-time hammer techno at a big-room venue.

a92fbe353474.curator_note: Mutate is Insomniac's harder techno brand at Exchange LA — Vendex is a serious booking for that room, but the dark industrial direction is a long way from the house and disco-flavored end you gravitate toward. One for nights when you want to be demolished, not moved.
a92fbe353474.description: Mutate presents Barcelona hard/industrial-techno DJ Vendex at Exchange LA, DTLA, 10pm, 21+, $20-83.

artist_notes.name: Paulita
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ active on the local underground circuit (RA profile: Ms_Paulita) — playing in the house/electronic space; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

artist_notes.name: Ms. Ed
artist_notes.note: LA underground selector; included per billing, no verified wider profile found.

artist_notes.name: Dirt Vibes
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/project name; included per billing, no verified label or broader profile found.

8213b45c6582.curator_note: Low Recordings throwing a free night at the Airliner — three local selectors, no marquee name, but the organizer label signals house-leaning intent and the free RSVP format makes it a low-stakes eastside add. Worth it if you're already in Lincoln Heights.
8213b45c6582.description: Reflections party by Low Recordings at The Airliner, Lincoln Heights — free with RSVP, 8pm-2am, with local DJs Paulita, Ms. Ed, and Dirt Vibes.

d3f6d17b2492.curator_note: A recovery party spun off from the Apocalypse bass-music festival — free entry and a TBA warehouse means it's exactly what it says on the label, a late-night continuation for that crowd. If bass isn't your thing the rest of the weekend has better options.
d3f6d17b2492.description: Unofficial Apocalypse Festival afterparty (Bass Recovery Day 1) at a TBA DTLA warehouse, starting 11:45pm, free — hosted by The LA Raver x Rave Haven with IGUESS, MA$TERPIECE, Rhino, OLRAZZLEDAZZLEE and YOHO.

cc7c2b4b40d5.curator_note: Blind Tiger's Nightshift afterhours at The Lexington — free before 1am but no lineup posted, which makes it a situational add rather than a destination. Check closer to the night for who's actually playing.
cc7c2b4b40d5.description: Nightshift After Hours at The Lexington, DTLA, by Blind Tiger — 11pm-5am, free with RSVP before 1am / $23 after, no lineup announced.

45eefe8f3cb7.curator_note: Electric Ave. is EMX's recurring tech-house night at Los Globos — 21+, no lineup detail, and the venue billing itself 'tech house, EDM' is a heads-up that it leans commercial rather than selector-focused. The location is walkable from Silver Lake but the music is unlikely to surprise.
45eefe8f3cb7.description: Electric Ave. recurring tech-house/EDM night at Los Globos, Silver Lake, 10pm, 21+, by promoter EMX — no lineup announced.

artist_notes.name: Satin Jackets
artist_notes.note: German producer Tim Bernhardt — flagship Eskimo Recordings artist, now releasing on his own Golden Hour label; polished nu-disco and deep house built around CHIC and Trevor Horn influences. Solidly club-functional in the sunny disco-house lane without much grit or edge.

84807f06fa2d.curator_note: Satin Jackets at The Spotlight is the slick Cahuenga-corridor version of a disco-house night — more festival stage than grubby warehouse, but if you want polished nu-disco in a proper room on a Friday night this is what it is. Closer to the Radio 1 end of the lane than Rush Hour.
84807f06fa2d.description: German nu-disco/house producer Satin Jackets (Eskimo/Golden Hour) plays The Spotlight on N. Cahuenga, Hollywood, 10pm-3am, $31 advance.

artist_notes.name: SVNX
artist_notes.note: LA-based house DJ; active in the local underground/house circuit. No verified wider profile found.

artist_notes.name: FUMIX
artist_notes.note: LA-area DJ in the local house orbit; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

90f392daf0b0.curator_note: Drifted Entertainment and Housedistrict doing a free afterhours spun off the Day Trip festival crowd — TBA location, 1am start, local house selectors. Skip if you're not already deep into Saturday night; worth knowing about if you are.
90f392daf0b0.description: Unofficial Day Trip Festival afterhours at a TBA DTLA location, starting 1am, free — with SVNX, AFTR RA1N, FUMIX and DAPHNE.

artist_notes.name: 2kinetik X Werd
artist_notes.note: LA-area drum and bass DJ duo/act; active on the local DnB circuit. No verified wider profile found.

artist_notes.name: Marketing Porpoises
artist_notes.note: LA DnB/jungle DJ project; included per billing, no verifiable wider profile found.

941a18c8636c.curator_note: Flow State's Junglist Edition at Aztec Brewery — a proper DnB night for the LA drum and bass faithful, $16 advance and a brewery setting is a low-stakes Friday. Not the lane, but if jungle is ever on the menu, this is the local format for it.
941a18c8636c.description: Flow State 'June Junglist Edition' drum and bass/jungle night at Aztec Brewery, 8pm, $16 advance — featuring 2kinetik x Werd, Marketing Porpoises and others; organized by Cue (Create Unite Engage).

562710e9bc68.curator_note: San Diego progressive house/trance afterhours with no lineup and an IG-only promo trail — the 'Life After Sunset' name reads like a Sunset Music Festival recovery. Far-flung for no billed names.
562710e9bc68.description: Life After Sunset Festival After Hours at a TBA San Diego location, 11pm, $20+ — progressive house, trance and techno organized by Steppin' Til Checkout; no lineup announced.

artist_notes.name: Raffi Kadafi
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and the b2b half here — active in the local house and underground circuit; included per billing, limited verifiable profile beyond local events.

artist_notes.name: Orbel
artist_notes.note: LA-area selector; the other b2b partner in this set — limited verifiable public footprint.

artist_notes.name: Enzo Muro
artist_notes.note: Listed in the lineup; LA electronic/house DJ. Limited verified profile found.

cfc03a32e02c.curator_note: B.LØWF at Bar Franca is the free Silver Lake option — a b2b set from Raffi Kadafi and Orbel with Enzo Muro, all local DJs, free entry, and one of the better small rooms on the eastside. The vibe is consistent even if the names aren't marquee.
cfc03a32e02c.description: B.LØWF party at Bar Franca, Silver Lake — free, 9pm-2am, with Raffi Kadafi b2b Orbel and Enzo Muro; organized by You Know What.

sounds_like: Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf (dinner-party chaos)
a1f1130029f3.curator_note: Olivia Wilde's A24 dinner-party comedy has Seth Rogen, Penélope Cruz, and Edward Norton — and a 92% Rotten Tomatoes score on opening week. A late 11pm show at the Vista for a film that's actually getting talked about is a rare combination.
a1f1130029f3.description: The Invite (2026, dir. Olivia Wilde, A24) — a comedy remake of the Spanish film The People Upstairs starring Seth Rogen, Penélope Cruz, Edward Norton and Wilde herself; late show at the Vista Theater, Los Feliz.

78aa54e51d53.curator_note: Wake in Fright (1971, Ted Kotcheff) is one of the great Australian films — a Sydney schoolteacher stranded in the outback and slowly unmade by masculinity, gambling, and heat. Exactly the kind of rep-cinema dark horse the Vista programs that's worth prioritizing over a middling DJ night.
78aa54e51d53.description: Wake in Fright (1971, dir. Ted Kotcheff) — the landmark Australian outback-noir about a teacher's psychological disintegration in the New South Wales interior; 8pm at the Vista Theater, Los Feliz.

artist_notes.name: KAYA (US)
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ playing Sunset at EDITION's Saturday house night — couldn't verify a label or wider bio. The venue's Saturday resident programming is curated by DJ Zen Freeman; KAYA appears in that orbit.

a3f6042f500d.curator_note: Sunset at EDITION's Saturday house night in the West Hollywood EDITION basement — a genuinely nice boutique-hotel room, and the venue's curatorial standard under Zen Freeman is solid. KAYA is unverified beyond the billing; worth it if you're already in WeHo.
a3f6042f500d.description: Sunset Saturdays recurring house night at Sunset at EDITION (West Hollywood EDITION hotel basement), 10pm, with KAYA (US).

d0746975448c.curator_note: A BET Awards weekend basketball-and-fashion event — not a music or club night in any meaningful sense. Skip.
d0746975448c.description: BET Awards Kickstart celebrity basketball/fashion event in Los Angeles, noon, $8 — organized by Vinrelo.

95e6fc86f917.curator_note: 18+ foam party at Los Globos — no DJ billing, no music context, not the lane.
95e6fc86f917.description: 18+ 'We Love LA' foam party at Los Globos, Silver Lake, 10pm, free — hosted by Shark Group.

005067882e99.curator_note: NIGHTSHIFT throwing a free midnight afterhours at 129 E 3rd — no lineup detail in the listing, which is par for the course with these. Viable if you're already out on the street at that hour and want to keep going; harder to plan around cold.
005067882e99.description: Free late-night afterhours party by NIGHTSHIFT at 129 E 3rd Street, DTLA, starting 11pm.

3d72506d1507.curator_note: Hard techno free-entry TBA from CLIMAX EVENTS — the industrial, pounding end of the techno spectrum rather than the hypnotic or groovy end. Not the lane here, so file it as a curiosity rather than a plan.
3d72506d1507.description: Free secret-location hard techno afterhours by CLIMAX EVENTS in DTLA, starting 11:45pm.

artist_notes.name: Collin Reeve
artist_notes.note: LA-based house DJ with ties to the Certified Groovers circuit — the 'For The Groovers' SoundCloud output points toward deep, selector-minded house rather than peak-time tools.

artist_notes.name: MXM
artist_notes.note: Long-standing Certified Groovers resident known for extended deep/minimal sets — he's played 8-hour and longer slots for the collective, which gives this all-night billing real credibility.

2e5710a4c036.curator_note: Certified Groovers is one of LA's most respected deep-house collectives — they've hosted DJ Sneak, Louie Vega and Karizma — so Collin Reeve and MXM going all night in a TBA DTLA location is a serious proposition even without a marquee international name on top. The format is built for people who want to stay.
2e5710a4c036.description: Certified Groovers all-night party (10pm-7am) at a TBA Downtown LA location with Collin Reeve and MXM, $17 advance.

artist_notes.name: Pan-Pot
artist_notes.note: Berlin duo Tassilo Ippenberger and Thomas Benedix — founders of Second State and HUMAN labels; known for powerful, undulating techno with kinetic groove; two LPs and a string of influential releases since the mid-2000s. Extended sets are their signature move.

artist_notes.name: DOOSTAH
artist_notes.note: DJ known for dynamic sets spanning peak-time techno to deep and groovy — builds immersive journeys through long-format track selection; part of the LA/international underground techno circuit.

artist_notes.name: Kitty Logic
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno and trance DJ/producer, co-founder of TRANS*CENDENT (a trans-centered underground party series in LA) — driving, hypnotic techno with trance elements.

b4799df0eb5f.curator_note: WORK landing Pan-Pot for a 4-hour extended set is the kind of booking that justifies chasing a TBA address — the Berlin duo plays rolling, kinetic techno with real architecture to it, and a long set format means they'll actually get somewhere rather than just hitting highlights. DOOSTAH and Kitty Logic are both interesting local support rather than filler.
b4799df0eb5f.description: WORK presents Pan-Pot (Second State, Berlin) for a 4-hour extended techno set alongside DOOSTAH and Kitty Logic, at a TBA Los Angeles location, 11pm-6am.

artist_notes.name: DEA MAGNA
artist_notes.note: LA-based producer, DJ and vocalist with classical music training — melodic house and techno, with live piano and vocals incorporated into sets. A distinct proposition at this hard-techno-leaning event.

artist_notes.name: Merimell
artist_notes.note: Estonian DJ, the 'first lady of techno' in her home country — releases on Desolat, Unknown to the Unknown and Killekill; driving, dark industrial techno; also runs her 'Machine Nation' radio show and events series.

4812141a4770.curator_note: ABSTRACT is an international hard techno brand (born in Málaga) and NEEK is a SoCal DJ who blew up through viral hard techno content — this skews heavier and more peak-industrial than the groovy or hypnotic techno end. Merimell's Desolat/Killekill pedigree is genuinely strong but the overall bill is hard-dance-adjacent rather than European-underground.
4812141a4770.description: ABSTRACT: Los Angeles at 1720 Arts District — international hard techno brand bringing NEEK, DEA MAGNA and Estonian techno DJ Merimell, 10pm-4am.

artist_notes.name: Kayzo
artist_notes.note: LA-based (Houston-born) DJ/producer Hayden Capuozzo — hybrid hard bass, hardstyle, dubstep and metalcore-influenced electronic; Welcome Records founder, Insomniac Discovery Project winner. High production, aggressive sound.

f7ba57f98f38.curator_note: Kayzo is the hardstyle-meets-dubstep end of the spectrum — heavy, aggressive, bass-forward and festival-sized at Exchange LA. Not the lane at all; mentioned for completeness on a busy 4th of July weekend.
f7ba57f98f38.description: Insomniac's Mutate night at Exchange LA with hard-bass/hardstyle producer-DJ Kayzo, 10pm-3am, $40.

artist_notes.name: Amina Jaguar
artist_notes.note: LA-based multilingual artist and DJ — 2x Grammy-considered; delivers afro house with a contagious, high-energy feel; regularly plays LA venues and outdoor events.

artist_notes.name: Shanto
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and producer active in the afro house and global grooves space; RA profile, SoundCloud presence.

artist_notes.name: Perstephanii
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/selector working the afro house circuit; co-billed with Shanto regularly on this organizer's events; limited verifiable bio beyond local presence.

be4939188e8d.curator_note: A rooftop afro house party at Jade Beverly Hills starting at 4pm is a genuinely appealing proposition — free before 6pm, a groove-forward sound, and an outdoor Beverly Hills terrace. Not a deep-underground booking, but Amina Jaguar is a real DJ with a real following, and the afro house format travels well in this setting.
be4939188e8d.description: Amore Rooftop Party at Jade Beverly Hills with Shanto, Perstephanii, Luigi Amore and Amina Jaguar playing afro house, 4pm-2am; free with RSVP before 6pm.

546af0d5d5dd.curator_note: The Invite is Olivia Wilde's A24 comedy remake of the Spanish film 'The People Upstairs' — Seth Rogen, Penélope Cruz and Edward Norton at a dinner party gone sideways. Premiered at Sundance to positive reviews and just opened in limited release; Vista is the right room for a new A24 limited-run.
546af0d5d5dd.description: A24's new comedy 'The Invite' (dir. Olivia Wilde; Seth Rogen, Penélope Cruz, Edward Norton) in limited release at Vista Theater, 7:30pm.

a58abde6a6b3.curator_note: Midnight Jaws at Vista is about as good as Friday night gets if you're not raving — John Williams score, great white, packed house at 11:30pm. The Vista's the perfect room for Spielberg's 1975 original loud and projected.
a58abde6a6b3.description: Midnight screening of Spielberg's Jaws (1975) at Vista Theater in Los Feliz, 11:30pm.

1fc49d028590.curator_note: Dan O'Bannon's 1985 zombie-punk classic — not Romero's serious undead but the anarchic, comedic spin that coined 'braaaains' and had a Cramps-and-45 Grave soundtrack. The Vista showing this on July 4th evening is just good programming.
1fc49d028590.description: Repertory screening of Dan O'Bannon's cult zombie-punk film 'The Return of the Living Dead' (1985) at Vista Theater, 8pm.

dbd663f94dec.curator_note: An 18+ Y2K nostalgia night at Los Globos — Nelly, Usher, early Kanye on a Friday in Silver Lake. The format is a decade-nostalgia club night, which is squarely in penalty territory. Pass.
dbd663f94dec.description: 18+ free 2000s hip-hop and R&B themed club night at Los Globos in Silver Lake, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Eli Escobar
artist_notes.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets move through soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

01f3e6c170c9.curator_note: A day-and-night Eli Escobar session at The Bridge — 7pm to 2am gives him real room to build, and he's one of the few selectors who can credibly go from sunset disco into proper late-night house without the wheels falling off. The July 4th timing suits the long-format groove.
01f3e6c170c9.description: Midnight Lovers presents Eli Escobar (Night People NYC, Tiki Disco) for a day-and-night set at The Bridge, DTLA, 7pm-2am, $22 advance.

artist_notes.name: Young Franco
artist_notes.note: Brisbane-born, Sydney-based producer/DJ (Joseph Da Rin de Barbera) — blends house, disco, hip-hop and funk into crowd-pleasing festival sets; associated with the Sweat It Out Australian collective; debut album 'It's Franky Baby' (2025). Four ARIA-Gold singles, 200M+ streams.

7d556fb301ff.curator_note: Young Franco doing a 4th of July pool party at Level 8 is exactly the right booking for this setting — his sunny, hip-hop-inflected house is built for open-air daytime situations, and the Level 8 rooftop-pool format is the closest thing in DTLA to a European holiday party. A good afternoon call if Pan-Pot or Robert Hood is the night plan.
7d556fb301ff.description: Stereo Punks and Orlove By Day present Young Franco (Sweat It Out, Brisbane) at the Level 8 DTLA rooftop pool party, July 4th, 2pm, $20.

5797c554d79b.curator_note: Paradisco is Stereo Punks' recurring Kiss Kiss Bang Bang series — 'Nica' appears to be the billed resident or guest for this edition, but no verifiable profile turns up under that name in this context. Free entry and the Koreatown location make it a low-stakes stop, but it's hard to recommend against the fully billed nights happening the same weekend.
5797c554d79b.description: Paradisco recurring night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang, Koreatown, with DJ Nica on the 4th of July, 10pm-2am, free.

artist_notes.name: OKAYVAL
artist_notes.note: Colombian-American DJ/producer based in Jacksonville, FL — tech house and techno with viral social presence; Insomniac Records signee; describes her influences as Martin Garrix (big-room) filtered through Mau P and Dom Dolla (modern tech house). Rising festival circuit name.

61428e90f126.curator_note: OKAYVAL is an Insomniac signee on the festival circuit — high-energy tech house that's more about the drop than the selection. The DTLA warehouse format suggests a more serious room than her usual festival stage, but the sound skews mainstream and peak-time rather than underground. Worth knowing she's in town; not the priority booking of the weekend.
61428e90f126.description: OKAYVAL (Insomniac Records) headlines a TBA DTLA warehouse show on July 4th, midnight start.

fc7159a30596.description: Club Cielo's 4th of July takeover at El Cid with a femme-forward international lineup — KEBRA (CDMX/BR), Linapary (COL), QUEENIE (US), and DINABN — playing Guaracha, Tribal, Baile Funk and Latin club sounds.

artist_notes.name: KEBRA
artist_notes.note: Mexico City/Brazil-based DJ in the Guaracha/Tribal/Latin club circuit — part of Club Cielo's femme-forward international roster.

artist_notes.name: Linapary
artist_notes.note: Colombia-based DJ in the Guaracha and Latin club sounds scene; recurring Club Cielo booking.

artist_notes.name: QUEENIE (US)
artist_notes.note: US-based selector on the femme Latin club/Guaracha circuit; limited public footprint beyond the Club Cielo billing.

artist_notes.name: DINABN
artist_notes.note: Club Cielo founder and LA-based DJ — the party is her recurring series at El Cid, built around Guaracha, Bubbling, Juke and Latin electronic.

fcbd25dfcf43.description: Late-night TBA-location afterhours organized by The LA Raver x Techtonik, headlined by Colombian-born, US-based dark tech-house DJ OKAYVAL with JACZ, SILVERTONE and XVIRAD.

artist_notes.name: OKAYVAL
artist_notes.note: Colombian-born, Jacksonville FL-based DJ/producer — dark, groove-heavy tech-house with a techno edge; her track 'Techno Sh' went viral in 2025 and she's built a fast-rising US following.

artist_notes.name: JACZ
artist_notes.note: Supporting local DJ on the LA techno/acid circuit; limited public profile.

artist_notes.name: SILVERTONE
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector on the underground techno/acid circuit; limited public profile.

artist_notes.name: XVIRAD
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the local acid/techno circuit; limited public profile.

adc9a5c6a146.description: Trinity presents hard techno and schranz at 1720 in the Arts District — DRAKK (Santa Clara Valley industrial techno) and TRIPTYKH (Dallas-based hard schranz/techno).

artist_notes.name: Drakk
artist_notes.note: Santa Clara Valley-rooted industrial techno DJ/producer active since 2018 — support from Amelie Lens, Ihatemodels and Kobosil signals where he sits: aggressive, industrial-leaning European techno energy.

artist_notes.name: Triptykh
artist_notes.note: Dallas-based hard techno/schranz DJ and producer — high-BPM, punishing peak-time sets in the early-2000s hard techno tradition; dedicated sound-pack and tutorial market has built him a cult following.

262bc08f8304.description: 4th of July rooftop party at Golden Hour / Level 8 DTLA, presented by Trip to Ibiza, with LA house veteran Adam Auburn playing tech house, deep house, minimal and disco with fireworks views from 8pm.

artist_notes.name: Adam Auburn
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ/producer with 15+ years at the wheel — Insomniac veteran (EDC, Nocturnal), runs his own Auburn Events production company and is one of the resident architects behind the Golden Hour Level 8 rooftop format.

3811f57ad3ce.description: Midnight 4th of July screening of Spielberg's 1975 ocean thriller Jaws at the Vista Theater in Los Feliz.

504fdfb0c59d.description: Vista Theater runs A24's 2026 comedy-drama The Invite (dir./starring Olivia Wilde, with Seth Rogen, Penélope Cruz, and Edward Norton) — a dinner-party-gone-wrong thriller.

13cbe6748424.description: Inland Groove's Groovers Inn 4th of July celebration at a secret DTLA venue — the collective's recurring free house party, billing TBD.

afc0b77eecee.description: La Casa Del Reggaeton, a recurring 18+ reggaeton club night at Los Globos in Silver Lake, 10pm, free.

469750d25f5c.description: Day Trip In The Park brings Sydney's Hayden James for an outdoor daytime house set at LA State Historic Park (2pm-8:30pm, 21+), with openers Gudfella and Local Singles.

artist_notes.name: Hayden James
artist_notes.note: Sydney producer signed to Future Classic — melodic, emotive house with multi-Platinum radio crossover; festival-circuit regular (Coachella, Lollapalooza) and a shade more pop-leaning than the deeper end of the taste.

artist_notes.name: Gudfella
artist_notes.note: Philippines-born, LA-based house producer (Kyle Domingo) — polished melodic/vocal house, 113M+ streams, Beatport #1 with 'Morning Coffee'; Vintage Culture-influenced festival-house sound.

152ca22ba09c.description: Cirra collective presents an afterhours TBA-location DTLA party with Day Thief, Faited and David Le Brun (listed as sosoftly), 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Day Thief
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ on the Cirra collective circuit; no verifiable public profile — included per billing only.

artist_notes.name: Faited
artist_notes.note: LA-based electronic DJ/producer; limited public footprint, recurring Cirra booking.

artist_notes.name: David Le Brun
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ affiliated with the Cirra collective; limited public profile — could not verify a label or sound with confidence.

f9740e4e2ca2.description: Great Quality Entertainment presents German melodic-techno duo Township Rebellion at 1720 in the Arts District with support from Trou and DENYC (10pm-3am, $21).

artist_notes.name: Township Rebellion
artist_notes.note: German duo — melodic and progressive techno built around deep, emotive soundscapes; labels include Rose Avenue, Hilomatik, Filth on Acid and Truesoul. Festival-circuit regulars (Fusion, Burning Man, EDC) and a staple at the progressive-techno end of the LA underground.

artist_notes.name: Trou
artist_notes.note: Supporting LA-based DJ on the progressive/melodic techno circuit; limited public profile.

artist_notes.name: DENYC
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the local techno circuit; limited public profile, included per billing.

6f32f9cbcf9b.description: Kevin Costner's Oscar-winning 1990 Lakota Sioux epic Dances with Wolves (3 hrs, 7 Academy Awards including Best Picture) screens at the Vista Theater in Los Feliz.

f198ba14b87d.description: Midnight screening of Hollywood 90028 (1973, dir. Christina Hornisher) — a newly 4K-restored LA exploitation film about a photographer descending into violence, now recognized as a poetic arthouse oddity.

5992d7ab4dcc.description: Factory 93 presents Brazilian tech-house disruptor Beltran in an open-to-close set at the 1756 Naud St outdoor venue in Chinatown (5pm, $113+).

artist_notes.name: Beltran
artist_notes.note: Brazilian DJ/producer (Juliano Beltran) — driving, percussive tech-house with Latin rhythm and low-end groove; Beatport #1 with 'Smack Yo' on Solid Grooves, viral YUMA/Coachella 2025 set, and support from Michael Bibi, Jamie Jones and Marco Carola. He's in Spotify rotation for a reason.

570a40fedd57.description: Divine LA and Apt4B Radio co-present The Groove Lab at a TBA DTLA venue, with East LA underground house and techno selector Rosie Love headlining (8pm).

artist_notes.name: Rosie Love
artist_notes.note: East LA house and techno DJ — self-described 'technologist and performer in the LA underground world,' shaped by the '90s house and techno movement; Apt4B Radio affiliate and recurring fixture in the city's grassroots scene.

1b2f8cd5a3d3.description: 1972 Peanuts animated film 'Snoopy Come Home,' directed by Bill Melendez with a Sherman Brothers score — a 10am Saturday morning matinee at the Vista.
1b2f8cd5a3d3.curator_note: A 10am Peanuts matinee at the Vista is a genuinely charming way to start a Saturday — the theater and the film deserve each other. Not the music lane, but worth a mention if the weekend needs an early anchor.

d8572d218587.description: Kevin Costner's 1990 Oscar-winning revisionist Western 'Dances with Wolves' (181 min, 7 Oscars including Best Picture) at the Vista, 7:30pm Friday.
d8572d218587.curator_note: Three hours of Costner on the frontier at the Vista — if you haven't seen it on a big screen, the John Barry score alone justifies it. This is the kind of rep that makes the Vista worth having in the neighborhood.

1b9443748a23.description: Midnight screening of 'Hollywood 90028' (1973), Christina Hornisher's obscure exploitation film about a young photographer's dark descent in Hollywood, at the Vista.
1b9443748a23.curator_note: A 1973 exploitation oddity about Hollywood's seedy underbelly playing at midnight at the Vista — exactly the kind of grindhouse sleeper Tarantino programs for the late crowd. Go for the context, not the prestige.

2759edca2c7e.description: The Groove Lab by Divine LA x Apt4B Radio — an 8pm–4am TBA-location night of house, tech-house, and disco at $12–34.

artist_notes.name: Apt4B Radio
artist_notes.note: LA collective staging intimate, intentional house/electronic mini-fests in lofts and local venues — no-phones policy, B2B format, roughly 20 active resident DJs.

2759edca2c7e.curator_note: Apt4B Radio runs properly intimate parties — the kind where you find out the location a couple hours before. House, tech-house, and disco from 8pm to 4am for $12 entry is a compelling Friday proposition if you want a room that's actually about the music.

ca1a5336ad01.description: Andrew Dominik's 2000 debut feature 'Chopper' starring Eric Bana as Australian criminal/author Mark 'Chopper' Read — Saturday evening at the Vista.
ca1a5336ad01.curator_note: Andrew Dominik's debut before 'Jesse James' and 'Blonde' — Eric Bana is genuinely disturbing in this, and it's the kind of film that rewards seeing cold. Vista is a great place to catch it if you've been putting it off.

3f495ac3b11f.description: Factory 93 presents Beltran open-to-close at 1756 Naud St in Chinatown — the Brazilian tech-house DJ doing a full Sunday set from 5pm, 21+.

artist_notes.name: Beltran
artist_notes.note: Juliano Beltran — Brazilian DJ/producer whose 'Smack Yo'' hit Beatport #1 overall; driving, Latin-percussive tech-house with a minimal edge. Supported by Jamie Jones, Michael Bibi, Marco Carola. This LA run sold out and added a second date.

3f495ac3b11f.curator_note: Beltran sold out the first LA date so Factory 93 added this Sunday open-to-close — Latin-percussive, low-slung tech-house for a full afternoon/evening at the Naud St warehouse. The percussive groove runs closer to Jamie Jones territory than bro-tech, so it plays.

d8180e2e3285.description: Lights Down Low presents Mura Masa DJ set at a TBA Downtown LA location — Thursday afterhours from 11pm.

artist_notes.name: Mura Masa
artist_notes.note: Guernsey-born Alexander Crossan — producer known for genre-blending alt-electronic (debut album Grammy-nominated), co-wrote PinkPantheress' global hit 'Boy's a Liar'. His DJ sets lean eclectic indie-dance rather than straight club fare.

d8180e2e3285.curator_note: Mura Masa's DJ sets are looser and more omnivorous than his studio work — expect indie-dance and electronic picks rather than a straight house or techno statement. Lights Down Low's TBA warehouse adds some mystique to a Thursday. Midweek, but worth tracking the location drop.

a5d9334e56d6.description: Club Blush — a recurring El Cid night devoted to melodic and progressive house anthems (RÜFÜS, ODESZA, Dom Dolla), Silver Lake, 10pm–2am, ~$7.
a5d9334e56d6.curator_note: Club Blush is essentially a tribute format for Cercle-era melodic anthems rather than a billed-DJ night — if you love the songs, it's a fun Silver Lake Friday; if you want selection, look elsewhere. Cheap entry, close to home, low stakes.

9c2d4fcf620b.description: Zepparella — an all-female Led Zeppelin tribute band — at the Roxy in West Hollywood, Friday 9pm.
9c2d4fcf620b.curator_note: A tribute act in the territory taste.yaml explicitly flags. If Led Zeppelin is what you're after on Friday night, the records are better company. Skip.

a40e575b8da3.description: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' (2026) in 70mm at the Vista Theater — the Homer epic starring Matt Damon, first film shot entirely on IMAX, opening night Friday July 17 at 10:30pm.
a40e575b8da3.curator_note: Nolan's 'Odyssey' is the film event of the summer and 70mm at the Vista is the right place to see it — the theater reopened with a 70mm system specifically for occasions like this. Friday late-night opening night; book fast.

3dfb0107c742.description: John Carpenter's 1984 sci-fi romance 'Starman' starring Jeff Bridges (Oscar nominated) and Karen Allen — Friday evening at the Vista, 8pm.
3dfb0107c742.curator_note: Carpenter's odd-one-out: a gentle alien road movie instead of horror, and the Jeff Bridges performance is the real draw. Worth the Friday night trip if you've never seen it projected properly — it's warmer than his reputation suggests.

4a1af7cf2124.description: Triple-bill at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood: Adam Spry (Bay Area indie-folk), Adam James (California indie-pop), and The Pretty Flowers (LA guitar-rock quartet), 7pm.

artist_notes.name: Adam Spry
artist_notes.note: Bay Area multi-instrumentalist — folky indie pop/rock with atmospheric arrangements; shares stages with The Mother Hips, Rayland Baxter.

artist_notes.name: Adam James
artist_notes.note: Coast-hopping indie singer-songwriter — slide guitars, reverb-doused melodies, California nostalgia. Regular Gold Diggers performer.

artist_notes.name: The Pretty Flowers
artist_notes.note: LA four-piece guitar-pop with Guided By Voices, Teenage Fanclub and Echo & the Bunnymen in their bloodline — new album 'Never Felt Bitter' out March 2026 on Forge Again Records.

4a1af7cf2124.curator_note: Three indie-leaning acts anchored by The Pretty Flowers, whose 2026 album is getting good notices in the jangle-pop/power-pop world. Gold Diggers is a fine room for this — small, sounds good, and $0 to walk in early for a 7pm show.

7b5fd6a26231.description: Acts of Service Sounds — a recurring soulful house night with resident DJ B-Wade at Gold Diggers, East Hollywood, 10:30pm, free entry.

artist_notes.name: B-Wade
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector (Instagram: @bwchillin) who runs the Acts of Service Sounds residency at Gold Diggers — deep, soulful, song-forward house sets.

7b5fd6a26231.curator_note: B-Wade's 'Acts of Service Sounds' residency is low-key and free — soulful house at close range in a small East Hollywood room. A solid late Friday if the bills elsewhere fall flat; the bar is genuinely good too.

bdd53b3c89a5.description: Markus Schulz open-to-close at Avalon Hollywood — the German-American trance and progressive DJ behind Coldharbour Recordings, Saturday 10pm–close.

artist_notes.name: Markus Schulz
artist_notes.note: German-American DJ/producer, Coldharbour Recordings founder — trance and progressive house, DJ Mag top 10 mainstay, best known for Global DJ Broadcast. Not the house/techno lane.

bdd53b3c89a5.curator_note: Markus Schulz is a trance lifer with a strong following at Avalon, but the Coldharbour sound is several lanes removed from the house and techno this taste profile orbits. Pass unless trance is on the menu that night.

adb4a466d3c2.description: Paradisco — Stereo Punk's recurring disco and house night inside Kiss Kiss Bang Bang at The LINE Hotel in Koreatown, Saturday 10pm–close.
adb4a466d3c2.curator_note: KKBB is a genuinely fun disco room inside The LINE — glowing floors, roller-skating dancers, and DJs who run from deep house to straight-up boogie. Paradisco is the regular Saturday night expression of that. No headliner billed but the concept holds; good option if you want something campier and closer to Wilshire than a warehouse.

8de56ecb032a.description: CLOSER's recurring THERMAL party series brings Amsterdam hard-groove techno DJ Beau Didier to a TBA DTLA warehouse for his LA debut, supported by THERMAL residents Kyrxmi, Hommes, and ÖTAK, 11pm.

artist_notes.name: Beau Didier
artist_notes.note: Amsterdam-born DJ/producer (b. 1999) and co-founder of the Vulged underground platform — bass-heavy, vocal-driven hard-groove techno with releases on Molekül, Mutual Rytm and [SELECTED]; has played HÖR Berlin and Awakenings. European underground pedigree; this is his LA debut.

artist_notes.name: Kyrxmi
artist_notes.note: CLOSER/THERMAL regular in the LA underground techno circuit; limited public footprint beyond local bookings.

artist_notes.name: ÖTAK
artist_notes.note: THERMAL resident support act; LA-based techno DJ on the CLOSER circuit.

8de56ecb032a.curator_note: THERMAL has been steadily importing European hard-groove names nobody else in LA is booking — Beau Didier landing for his debut fits that pattern exactly. If you want the driving, bass-forward end of techno (closer to Awakenings than Berghain), this is the TBA night to chase.

5a954993cb7d.description: Disconic — the LA promoter behind Marcellus Pittman bookings — presents a TBA late night with LA-based selectors Juniör, Kana Hishiya, John Smith and resident bilaliwood, 11pm.

artist_notes.name: Kana Hishiya
artist_notes.note: Japanese-born, LA-based DJ and producer — house and techno spanning punchy basslines through minimal and broken beats; has played alongside Kenny Larkin and appeared on the MEOKO podcast; a genuine cornerstone of the LA underground community.

artist_notes.name: bilaliwood
artist_notes.note: LA-based Disconic resident — has supported DāM-FunK on the DTLA underground circuit; house and techno selector building a residency with this promoter.

artist_notes.name: John Smith
artist_notes.note: LA-based underground house/techno selector; played the 'If You Know You Know' series with Binh (March 2026); limited wider public footprint beyond the local circuit.

5a954993cb7d.curator_note: Disconic knows how to curate a room — they've had Marcellus Pittman in on the same TBA format, and Kana Hishiya is one of the more versatile technical selectors in the local underground. A step below a marquee booking but the right night if you want to hear what the LA house scene actually sounds like right now.

artist_notes.name: Charlotte de Witte
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno titan (Rekids, her own KNTXT label) — relentlessly driving, hypnotic sets; one of the most consistently excellent live techno artists in the world. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno DJ and producer, LENSKE label founder — high-energy, acid-flecked, peak-time techno with genuine emotional resonance. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Anetha
artist_notes.note: Bordeaux-born French techno DJ/producer, Mama Told Ya label founder — driving post-club and industrial-flecked techno with feminist politics baked in; has played Berghain, fabric.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Warsaw-born Martyna Maja — high-speed industrial techno, EBM and hardcore-inflected; Repitch, Intrepid Skin, Discwoman resident. One of the sharpest fast-techno voices to emerge from Eastern Europe.

artist_notes.name: Interplanetary Criminal
artist_notes.note: Manchester producer Zachary Koa Bruce — co-founded ATW Records with Main Phase; 'B.O.T.A.' with Eliza Rose went UK #1 in 2022. Spearheading the current wave of speed garage and bassline into festival crossover.

artist_notes.name: Luuk van Dijk
artist_notes.note: Amsterdam DJ/producer (Dark Side of the Sun, Hot Creations, Solid Grooves) — fluid house-to-techno sets with genuine Awakenings / Circoloco pedigree; younger generation European club talent.

artist_notes.name: Sammy Virji
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer — UK garage, bassline and bass house; 'If U Need It' pushed 50M+ streams; a driving force in bringing UKG to US festival audiences.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ and Turbo Recordings founder — introduced Gesaffelstein, Chromeo and Charlotte de Witte to the label; his wry electro and techno feel timeless. A scene elder who belongs on any credible festival lineup.

4dd13aaa260f.curator_note: HARD Summer's roster this year has more depth than the name suggests — Charlotte de Witte and Amelie Lens anchoring the techno end, DJ Seinfeld bringing his particular emotional-wreck house, and VTSS and Anetha keeping the European underground well represented. Day 1 is the stronger card between the two; if you're only going once, this is the day.
4dd13aaa260f.description: HARD Summer Music Festival Day 1 at Hollywood Park Grounds, Inglewood — open-air two-day electronic festival featuring Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens, DJ Seinfeld, Mau P, VTSS, Anetha, Chris Lorenzo, Vintage Culture, Tiga and 60+ others.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno DJ/producer and LENSKE label founder — relentless, acid-laced peak-time sets with real emotional lift; Factory 93 has trusted her with Grand Park before. Tracked name.

d535a0dbfe40.curator_note: Factory 93 giving Amelie Lens an extended solo set at Grand Park, day-to-dusk, is exactly the format she excels in — she's one of the few artists whose Belgian techno vocabulary stays compelling for three-plus hours. The open-air park setting softens what would otherwise be a full Berghain proposition.
d535a0dbfe40.description: Factory 93 presents Amelie Lens in an extended day-to-dusk solo set at Grand Park in DTLA, spanning techno, acid and trance.

artist_notes.name: discostan
artist_notes.note: LA collective co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South/West Asian and North African music: '80s diaspora disco, folkloric re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW. A genuinely singular LA institution.

artist_notes.name: Kohinoorgasm
artist_notes.note: Josephine Shetty — LA/Berkeley-based South Asian queer artist doing 'azaadi pop' — hypnotic synth beats with ethereal vocals and decolonial politics woven in; minimalist electronic production with raw emotional directness. A perfect fit for discostan's 15th anniversary.

2ebecef33ac3.curator_note: Fifteen years of discostan's 'time-bending diasporic dancefloor' at El Cid, with a midnight live performance from Kohinoorgasm — this is the anniversary event, not a regular edition. If you've been meaning to finally check this night, this is the occasion.
2ebecef33ac3.description: discostan's 15th anniversary party at El Cid, Silver Lake — the LA SWANA diaspora dance collective celebrating with a midnight live set from Kohinoorgasm; 9:30pm-2am, $11.50-17.25.
