artist_notes.name: Tigerbalm
artist_notes.note: London-based DJ/producer Rose Robinson — global-inflected disco and Afro-house; debut album 'International Love Affair' on Ubiquity, second album 'Bubblegum Discos' (2026) out on Razor N Tape and 20/20 Vision. Deep tribal-to-disco selects with African and Latin American textures.

artist_notes.name: Hayes Bradley
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer and music supervisor — founded the vinyl-only label These Things Take Time while at Smart Bar Chicago; toured with Kaytranada; opened for James Blake, Flume and Kelly Lee Owens. Cinematic breakbeat-meets-ambient club sound with real selector depth.

artist_notes.name: Teo Amo
artist_notes.note: LA-based singer-producer performing a hybrid DJ/live set here — limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings; included on billing confidence.

3921a04ebfe3.curator_note: Synoptico is an art/performance context inside Psst Studio, not a traditional club — hard-hitting house and edits alongside the immersive visual work is an unusual hybrid that tends to either be genuinely surprising or just noisy. Tigerbalm and Hayes Bradley are credible selectors; the art-space format sets this apart from a straight club night.
3921a04ebfe3.description: Synoptico two-night immersive art-performance event at Psst Studio with house and club edits from Tigerbalm, Hayes Bradley, Teo Amo (hybrid live/DJ), Blackpaw and Rampage; 7pm-2am, $20-35.

92ef96279309.curator_note: Duplicate listing for the Synoptico event at Psst Studio — same night and lineup as 3921a04ebfe3. The RA-sourced record is the primary one; this 19hz entry adds the house/disco genre tags from the venue name but has no additional detail.
92ef96279309.description: Duplicate entry: Synoptico house/disco night at Psstudio, June 27, 7pm-2am — same event as the RA listing (id: 3921a04ebfe3).

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: Berlin-born Alex Ridha — electro-techno and tech-house producer (Boysnoize Records), frequent collab partner of Skrillex and Daft Punk-adjacent; a festival mainstay who bridges underground credibility with mass-appeal energy.

52241f8a3d48.curator_note: Day 2 of HARD Summer has a slightly different configuration — Amelie Lens and Vintage Culture carry over but the supporting cards shift, with Boys Noize and VTSS giving it a more electro-techno center of gravity. Day 1 is the stronger pick if you're choosing between them, but Day 2 works if the Sunday timing suits better.
52241f8a3d48.description: HARD Summer Music Festival Day 2 at Hollywood Park Grounds, Inglewood — Amelie Lens, VTSS, Boys Noize, Vintage Culture, Tiga, Sammy Virji, Knock2, RL Grime and others.

artist_notes.name: ashtre
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found — included on billing confidence.

ea88536e890a.curator_note: Butterground is a local DTLA house collective running TBA-location parties — all-local lineup (Pocari G, Ashtre, Costa, Oso Disco, Blaze Claze), no marquee name. Most of these artists are already noted in the cache from the earlier July 4th edition. This is the June 27th version of the same format: late-night, local, $25.
ea88536e890a.description: Butterground house collective party at a TBA DTLA location with Pocari G, Ashtre, Costa, Oso Disco and Blaze Claze, 10pm-4am, $25.

8c932c3eac8d.curator_note: Spam listing — this is an airline ticket-correction advertisement falsely attributed to the New Beverly Cinema. Not a real event; scored erroneously due to 'Ame' substring match. Should be filtered from catalog.
8c932c3eac8d.description: SPAM: Not a real event — an EasyJet name-correction advertisement that entered the catalog via Posh with a fabricated New Beverly Cinema attribution.

9cbe77cbc343.curator_note: Spam listing — JetSmart ticket-correction advertisement falsely placed at the New Beverly Cinema. Same pattern as 8c932c3eac8d; both should be removed from catalog.
9cbe77cbc343.description: SPAM: Not a real event — a JetSmart airline name-correction advertisement that entered the catalog via Posh with a fabricated New Beverly Cinema attribution.

artist_notes.name: GG (5)
artist_notes.note: RA-listed artist tagged to this Townhouse Venice booking — insufficient public information to establish genre or scene; name is too generic to verify with confidence. Included on billing only.

00bfe8a0d235.curator_note: GOOD GAME at Townhouse Venice is a recurring late-night with no lineup detail beyond the RA stub 'GG (5)' — not enough information to evaluate. The Townhouse is a divey Venice bar rather than a proper club, which limits ceiling. Low-priority pick without more detail.
00bfe8a0d235.description: GOOD GAME recurring late-night electronic event at Townhouse bar in Venice, 10pm.

089c71f526eb.curator_note: An anime/cosplay rave at Dave & Busters — a free novelty event organized by Ledisko Nights, not a credible electronic night. The venue and concept are firmly in the EDM-novelty lane rather than anything close to the house/techno taste profile.
089c71f526eb.description: Anime-themed cosplay rave at Dave & Busters organized by Ledisko Nights, July 3, 10pm, free.

84180a2db7a4.curator_note: DREAMBASH at Level 8 on July 4th — the rooftop is obviously appealing (the Sunset Sessions venue) but this is an open-format RSVP party from an unverified promoter with no DJ billing, not the house-and-vinyl series. The name and free entry suggest crowd-building rather than curation.
84180a2db7a4.description: DREAMBASH open-format party at Level 8 DTLA rooftop, July 4th, 9pm, free — no DJ lineup detailed.

artist_notes.name: The Roamers
artist_notes.note: Insufficient public information to establish genre or background with confidence — an RA listing at the Redwood Bar and Grill in DTLA, which programs rock and blues. The venue gazetteer flags 'the redwood' as rock; included on that basis.

9fd90f37b8e7.curator_note: The Roamers at the Redwood Bar in DTLA — this is the rock/blues dive-bar room, not an electronic night. No public artist detail available to evaluate further; the high score appears to be a false 'Ame' substring match. Skip without more information.
9fd90f37b8e7.description: The Roamers live at The Redwood Bar And Grill, DTLA, 8pm.

artist_notes.name: Porter Robinson
artist_notes.note: LA-based electronic producer and DJ — pioneered a strand of melodic, emotionally dense electronic music ('Worlds', 2014; 'Nurture', 2021) that sits somewhere between IDM, J-pop and rave. Strong Spotify-affinity signal in Ari's rotation.

artist_notes.name: Louis the Child
artist_notes.note: Chicago indie-electronic duo (Robby Hauldren and Freddy Kennett) — bright, vocal-forward melodic electronic with indie crossover appeal; Interscope-signed.

artist_notes.name: What So Not
artist_notes.note: Australian producer Chris Emerson — melodic bass music and future bass; formerly half of Flume's early project. Insomniac circuit regular.

5b8636a94da3.curator_note: Lost in Dreams is Insomniac's melodic/future-bass festival brand — Porter Robinson headlining makes it genuinely interesting (Nurture-era live show has been exceptional), but the surrounding lineup is squarely Insomniac young-crowd territory. Worth it for Porter Robinson specifically if that's your lane.
5b8636a94da3.description: Lost in Dreams LA festival at LA State Historic Park, Chinatown — Insomniac's melodic/future-bass event headlined by Porter Robinson with Dabin, Louis the Child, Audien, William Black and What So Not; July 11-12, 18+.

artist_notes.name: Anton Tumas
artist_notes.note: Long Beach DJ, founder of Subtract Music and the organizer of this festival — selects at the thoughtful, forward-thinking edge of house and techno; curator rather than crowd-pleaser.

artist_notes.name: Doc Martin
artist_notes.note: LA underground house and techno stalwart — San Francisco scene veteran, Sublevel label and events founder (25 years); 40 years behind the decks in 2026 with a fluid deep-house-to-tribal-bass range that remains genuinely authoritative.

artist_notes.name: Lee Burridge
artist_notes.note: British DJ/producer and All Day I Dream label founder — pioneered 'organic house' (melodic, dreamlike, Balearic-adjacent) starting with Brooklyn rooftop parties in 2007; the label's sound now defines an entire Beatport subgenre. Extended sets are his signature.

artist_notes.name: Radio Slave
artist_notes.note: Matt Edwards — Berlin-based British DJ/producer and Rekids label co-founder; collaborated with Nina Kraviz, Carl Craig, Robert Hood and Peggy Gou on the imprint. Firm, driving house and techno with real label-history weight.

artist_notes.name: Mikey Lion
artist_notes.note: San Diego DJ and co-founder of the Desert Hearts movement (began as a 200-person renegade Mojave gathering in 2012); Desert Hearts Records has become a community-anchored label for house and techno with tribal and psychedelic inflections.

artist_notes.name: Justin Martin
artist_notes.note: San Francisco DJ/producer and Dirtybird co-founder alongside Claude VonStroke — melodic, playful bass-house with emotional depth; 'Grapefruit' is still a touchstone. Launched his own label 'What To Do…' in 2020.

artist_notes.name: DJ Colette
artist_notes.note: Chicago house DJ, singer and Smart Bar resident — pioneered live vocal-over-DJ-set technique; her long-form performances blend soulful, full-range house with genuine showmanship. An under-celebrated veteran of the scene.

artist_notes.name: DAVI
artist_notes.note: Armenian-born, LA-based DJ/producer — releases on Crosstown Rebels, All Day I Dream and RADIANT; melodic house and techno with a driving dancefloor sensibility; played alongside Hernan Cattaneo and Nick Warren.

86ca88c4e980.curator_note: The 11th Love Long Beach at Shoreline Aquatic Park is a genuinely well-programmed daytime outdoor — Anton Tumas and Doc Martin as local anchors, Lee Burridge doing what he does best in the open air, and Radio Slave bringing real Rekids-lineage club weight. It's Long Beach so factor the drive, but the Subtract stage lineup justifies it.
86ca88c4e980.description: 11th Annual Love Long Beach Festival at Shoreline Aquatic Park — two-day outdoor house/techno daytime event with Lee Burridge, Doc Martin, Radio Slave, DJ Minx, Mikey Lion, Justin Martin, DJ Colette, DAVI and Anton Tumas on the Subtract Stage; July 18-19.

9a0fd9893571.description: Information's all-vinyl night at a TBA downtown location with LA selectors Taylor Shockley, Luke Mele, and CHOÍCE on turntables only.

artist_notes.name: Taylor Shockley
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector and Information crew regular — vinyl-only house and disco, fixtures of the city's underground all-wax circuit.

artist_notes.name: Luke Mele
artist_notes.note: LA digger and Information affiliate — deep house and disco-leaning vinyl sets; low public footprint but recurs on LA's quality all-vinyl bills.

artist_notes.name: CHOÍCE
artist_notes.note: LA DJ on the Information circuit; couldn't verify a clear label home or scene origin beyond the local all-vinyl/house underground.

9a0fd9893571.curator_note: Information has quietly become one of LA's most consistent all-vinyl programs — no laptops, no watered-down bookings. This July edition feels like the right call if you want a proper wax night without chasing a TBA address for a marquee name.

0eb89ce23c2b.description: Certified Groovers presents Toronto house don Demuir open-to-close at a TBA downtown LA location, starting 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Demuir
artist_notes.note: Toronto-born DJ/producer (Purveyor Underground, Hot Creations, Classic Music Company) — funky, jackin', soulful house; multiple Beatport #1 Jacking House producer years. Recurring Certified Groovers headliner in LA.

0eb89ce23c2b.curator_note: Demuir's jackin' house sets at Certified Groovers run long and ride hard — not the introspective-vinyl end of the spectrum, but a proper sweat-it-out Saturday-night machine. Good pick if you want function over selection.

8a862e604d08.description: Midnight Lovers presents Italian-Berlin DJ Massimiliano Pagliara alongside Masha Mar and James Axon at The Bridge in DTLA.

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Puglia-born, Berlin-based selector with Berghain residencies and records on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton, and Permanent Vacation — Italo-flicker Balearic house meets deep disco; curates his own Funnuvojere Records label. German Record Critics' Award winner for 2022 album See You in Paradise.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born LA selector (NTS, dublab; co-founder Dig Deeper LA) — cosmic disco, tribal and left-field deep house. Midnight Lovers crew regular.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based Midnight Lovers crew selector; limited public bio but a regular on the crew's Balearic-leaning bills.

8a862e604d08.curator_note: Pagliara's sets at Berghain run through Italo flickers, Balearic warmth, and deeper house without ever feeling forced into a genre box — the Midnight Lovers context here is well-matched. September date, but worth a calendar note now.

48e360ba751a.description: SOFI TUKKER headline the Greek Theatre on Sept 19 with Chicago R&B-electronic duo DRAMA in support.

artist_notes.name: DRAMA
artist_notes.note: Chicago duo of producer Na'el Shehade and vocalist Via Rosa — soulful R&B fused with dance-floor-adjacent electronics, spanning jazz, bossa nova and club textures; independent releases, debut album Dance Without Me (2020). Worth catching as the opener.

48e360ba751a.curator_note: SOFI TUKKER at the Greek is a summer-night no-brainer if you're already in the 'big fun electronic show' mode — global-inflected dance-pop that's far more interesting live than a streaming playlist implies, and DRAMA as opener is a genuine bonus.

cf044cb77173.description: ORLOVE's Midnite City indie disco night at The Moroccan Lounge: a DJ set exploring the electronic side of indie with artists from Justice to LCD Soundsystem to MGMT.

artist_notes.name: ORLOVE
artist_notes.note: LA promoter/DJ (Orlovebynight) running a monthly indie-electronic night at The Moroccan — Daft Punk, French Touch, Soulwax, MGMT-territory. More of a theme-night concept than a headliner booking; fun if that's the mood.

cf044cb77173.curator_note: Midnite City is a DJ-plays-records indie disco concept, not a live show — closer to a themed dance night than a curated selector set. Good for the Saturday if you'd rather move to Disclosure and MGMT than think too hard about it.

3061917831bd.description: Certified Groovers hosts California-born Berlin-based Gene On Earth (Limousine Dream) for a late-night TBA-location set in downtown LA.

artist_notes.name: Gene On Earth
artist_notes.note: California-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer who runs the Limousine Dream label — lush, cosmic, house-forward with 90s-nod bleeps and organ bass; also releases on Youandewan's Small Hours and Voigtmann's Subsequent. The 'Sound of Limo' comp he curated featured Roza Terenzi, Sweely, Dyed Soundorom.

3061917831bd.curator_note: Gene On Earth's Limousine Dream sound — bouncing hi-hats, cosmic bleeps, a warm lush house lilt — fits the rooftop-groove taste tighter than most of the Certified Groovers bills. California native playing the city again: a better reason to chase the TBA address than usual.

edab80bd44cb.description: Overmono's Pure Devotion World Tour live show at Hollywood Palladium, with a Vinyl Room opening from 6:30pm.
edab80bd44cb.curator_note: Tom and Ed Russell's Pure Devotion (XL, August 2026) leans into analogue hardware and emotional weight — it's the kind of album that earns a proper live show rather than a DJ set. The Palladium is a good room for it, and the early Vinyl Room is a nice bonus for arriving on time.

4eea8f28c93f.description: Analog Outlaw's free counterculture physical media fair at 2220 Arts + Archives: records, books, VHS, zines and fringe publications from indie vendors, 11am–6pm.
4eea8f28c93f.curator_note: A record-and-weird-books fair at 2220 rather than the music room — the overlap with the venue you like is more about the space than a lineup. Free, daytime, and first West Coast appearance of Japanese Avant Garde Books is a pull if you're already in the neighborhood.

5f0cd6635f8e.description: Llévame De Gira presents post-hardcore/punk bill at The Smell with these severed hands, Madison Violet, and Black Cat Coalition, $10.

artist_notes.name: these severed hands
artist_notes.note: IE-based 'pastel post-hardcore' band — melodic, textured, self-described post-hardcore; debut album act one (August 2025). Not the classic punk end, more emo-adjacent.

artist_notes.name: Madison Violet
artist_notes.note: Listed on this bill; couldn't verify a clear bio — likely a local LA indie act rather than the Toronto folk duo of the same name. Taking the DIY billing at face value.

artist_notes.name: Black Cat Coalition
artist_notes.note: Collective or band on this bill; no verifiable public footprint found. Listed per the event detail.

5f0cd6635f8e.curator_note: A $10 Smell show that's firmly in the DIY-punk room rather than anywhere near the electronic lane — worth noting for completeness, but not a priority night unless you're deep in that scene.

3230dbfd7fb2.description: SWXCH 006 LA Pride warehouse party with French-Berlin techno DJ Lea Occhi (Spectrum, west coast debut) and German queer-underground DJ softchaos, 11pm–5am.

artist_notes.name: Lea Occhi
artist_notes.note: Paris-born, Berlin-based DJ and co-founder of Spectrum (the LGBTQIA+ collective at La Station Gare des Mines) — groove-led rhythms over swinging deep techno; played Berghain, Tresor, Bassiani. West coast debut per the billing.

artist_notes.name: softchaos
artist_notes.note: Berlin-based DJ, member of the Toro art collective — blends techno, Baltimore club, drum & bass and breaks; queer dancefloor-liberationist in the mold of the Gegen/Panorama Bar underground.

3230dbfd7fb2.curator_note: Lea Occhi's west-coast debut at a TBA warehouse for Pride — she's the real draw, the kind of swinging deep-techno selector who earns the late-night format rather than just filling it. Worth chasing the location drop if the techno end of the weekend is calling.

d10660bfcf11.description: Panic Room late-night at a TBA Silver Lake location with Shane Thomas, Rob Aquino, and Australian indie-pop-electronic artist Banoffee.

artist_notes.name: Banoffee
artist_notes.note: Melbourne-born musician Martha Brown — mutant pop and electronic, somewhere between alt-R&B and club music (Dot Dash, Two Bright Lakes); known for albums Look at Us Now Dad and Tear Tracks. The DJ context here is unusual for her; she's more a vocalist/producer than a selector.

artist_notes.name: Shane Thomas
artist_notes.note: LA electronic DJ on the local underground circuit; limited verifiable public bio.

artist_notes.name: Rob Aquino
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, local circuit; couldn't verify a clear scene affiliation or label home beyond the local electronic underground.

d10660bfcf11.curator_note: Panic Room is a local crew and Banoffee is a genuinely interesting artist — but her presence as a DJ here rather than a performer is a bit of a wildcard. Worth a look if you're already staying up late nearby, lower priority than the bigger weekend bills.

413f975dfff9.description: Extra Sensory X Vice Pride collab at Rave DEN — 10pm–6am with a billed 'top-secret guest from London' headlining Heidi Lawden, Stacy Christine and local selectors.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA DJ on the queer underground circuit; recurring on Extra Sensory bills. Limited public bio outside local event listings.

artist_notes.name: Michelle Manetti
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and Extra Sensory affiliate; listed as part of the lineup; no verifiable label or wider scene footprint found.

413f975dfff9.curator_note: The 'secret guest from London' hook is either a genuine coup or a marketing hedge — the RA pick suggests the organizers have something real lined up. If it's the right London name, this could be the surprise of the Pride weekend; if not, you're paying $35–56 for a strong local bill.

b29dd7e07f50.description: SET Underground presents Goldcap open-to-close for 8 hours (10pm–sunrise) at a TBA LA location — his annual birthday sanctuary set.

artist_notes.name: Goldcap
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer Berge Sahakian — organic/melodic house with world-music textures; releases on Sol Selectas and Pipe & Pochet; inspired by Lee Burridge and Dixon. Known for long, immersive open-to-close sets at intimate underground events.

b29dd7e07f50.curator_note: Eight hours of Goldcap is a commitment, but it's the right kind — organic, melodic, world-inflected house that builds properly instead of hitting a peak and staying there. The birthday-bash premise usually means he brings extra energy. Worthwhile if that extended-set style is your Saturday.

f70433d950df.description: Information's all-vinyl outdoor gathering (10pm–5am) with Shakolin and Slip, $29 pre.

artist_notes.name: Shakolin
artist_notes.note: Ukrainian selector, long-time Closer Kyiv resident now based in Berlin — co-runs Delirious, the vinyl-only label and Panorama Bar party series with partner Karine. Deep digger whose debut EP Destination (Unknown) came out on his own Delirious imprint.

artist_notes.name: Slip
artist_notes.note: Information crew selector; appears on multiple all-vinyl bills in LA. Couldn't verify a wider label affiliation or scene origin beyond the local underground.

f70433d950df.curator_note: Shakolin at a Panorama Bar party is the kind of selector who earns an outdoor all-vinyl format — deep wax knowledge, none of the showiness. For a Pride Saturday that's less about the crowd and more about what's on the turntables, this is a quiet recommendation.

b028d3b632b3.description: [CANCELLED] Paradise Vice at The Bridge with Brazilian techno pioneer Renato Cohen (LA debut), UK Afro-disco selector Tigerbalm, and local DJ Blackpaw.

artist_notes.name: Renato Cohen
artist_notes.note: São Paulo techno pioneer (b. 1974) — Carl Cox's Intec label, Technasia remixes, Chris Liebing's CLR; multiple Brazilian producer-of-the-year awards. His Intec track 'Pontapé' is a catalog marker. LA debut was slated here.

artist_notes.name: Tigerbalm
artist_notes.note: British DJ/producer Rose Robinson (Brixton) — boogie, nu-disco and proto-house with African, Latin and SE Asian influences; releases on Razor-N-Tape, Wonderwheel, Ubiquity Records. Her Afro-disco flavour is a different lane from Cohen's techno.

b028d3b632b3.curator_note: Cancelled — noting Renato Cohen's LA debut got pulled, and the Tigerbalm booking was an interesting contrast with the techno headliner. One to reschedule-watch.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffé.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

b wade.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

lydo.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

frankie teardrop.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

tamara lanza.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

antal.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

reverberation radio.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

richie hawtin.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

john gerrard.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

dave harrington.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

john dwyer.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

spencer zahn.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

aaron steele.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

tom dolas.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

yaeji.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL Recordings, second album 'With A Hammer' (2023). Breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017. On a dedicated DJ-set North American summer tour 2026. Tracked name.

alima lee.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

adam beyer.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno; one of the most reliably excellent festival techno sets alive. Tracked name.

cloonee.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers. Tracked name.

loco dice.note: Tunisian-German DJ Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; Space/Hi Ibiza resident; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythms into house and tech house. Records on Ovum, M-nus, Cadenza, Cocoon.

hi-lo.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has released on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno bridging festival and underground.

elderbrook.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' with CamelPhat was Grammy-nominated 2018; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act, not a DJ set.

hayden james.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); worked with Gorgon City and Katy Perry; RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but slightly more radio-pop.

sidepiece.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house with Motown and '90s soul edits.

westend.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped define modern American tech house; Kick & Bass Records founder; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

josh baker.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project; also runs SYNTHO production school.

riordan.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm; also on Black Book and Catch & Release.

greg 99.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee (6.6M streams); Insomniac Records debut.

stacey pullen.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse in the '90s; Blackflag Recordings founder; acclaimed DJ-Kicks (1996); also releases as Bango, Kosmik Messenger and Silent Phase. Tracked name.

bae bae.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave (DTLA's queer-Black underground party). Sets weave footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through an explicitly Black-diasporic and femme lens; NTS and Dublab radio host.

nish.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

dj toka.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

robert hood.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — co-founded Underground Resistance with Jeff Mills and Mad Mike Banks; stripped techno to bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994, Tresor/Axis). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). Tracked name.

disco zombie.note: LA techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno; co-hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

onyx.note: LA-based underground techno DJ, active on the WORK / INCOGNITO circuit; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

rubbermiro.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

jayda g.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ Jacinda Gulley — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul. Tracked name.

enayet.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh; polyrhythmic club music with South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh.

k wata.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; produced for Yaeji; contributed to james K 'Friend' remix album.

discostan.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South/West Asian and North African music: '80s diaspora disco, folkloric sounds, re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW.

pocari g.note: LA-based house DJ active on the local underground circuit; limited wider public footprint.

ashtre.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found.

oso disco.note: LA disco/house DJ; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

blaze claze.note: LA-based DJ; included per billing, no wider verifiable profile found.

halo varga.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn Records, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owner of Artifact Record Shop. Deep Chicago house roots with a European finish.

dylan payne.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

highkin'.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

flying mojito bros.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda.

brainstory.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; primarily a live band, not a DJ act. Some groove DNA but a different lane from the dance floor.

ginger root.note: Cameron Lew's solo project from Huntington Beach — immaculately crafted indie soul, alt-disco, boogie and Japanese city pop; primarily a live band but occasionally performs DJ sets. Influences include Vulfpeck, Toro y Moi and Yellow Magic Orchestra.

eli escobar.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

vendex.note: Barcelona-born dark/industrial/acid hard-techno DJ and producer — releases on Soma Records, Occult Rhythms, Critical Revolution among others; plays Rotterdam Rave and Verknipt circuit. Not the groove/selector lane; this is peak-time hammer techno at a big-room venue.

paulita.note: LA-based DJ active on the local underground circuit (RA profile: Ms_Paulita) — playing in the house/electronic space; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

ms ed.note: LA underground selector; included per billing, no verified wider profile found.

dirt vibes.note: LA-based DJ/project name; included per billing, no verified label or broader profile found.

satin jackets.note: German producer Tim Bernhardt — flagship Eskimo Recordings artist, now releasing on his own Golden Hour label; polished nu-disco and deep house built around CHIC and Trevor Horn influences. Solidly club-functional in the sunny disco-house lane without much grit or edge.

svnx.note: LA-based house DJ; active in the local underground/house circuit. No verified wider profile found.

fumix.note: LA-area DJ in the local house orbit; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

2kinetik x werd.note: LA-area drum and bass DJ duo/act; active on the local DnB circuit. No verified wider profile found.

marketing porpoises.note: LA DnB/jungle DJ project; included per billing, no verifiable wider profile found.

raffi kadafi.note: LA-based DJ and the b2b half here — active in the local house and underground circuit; included per billing, limited verifiable profile beyond local events.

orbel.note: LA-area selector; the other b2b partner in this set — limited verifiable public footprint.

enzo muro.note: Listed in the lineup; LA electronic/house DJ. Limited verified profile found.

kaya us.note: LA-based DJ playing Sunset at EDITION's Saturday house night — couldn't verify a label or wider bio. The venue's Saturday resident programming is curated by DJ Zen Freeman; KAYA appears in that orbit.

collin reeve.note: LA-based house DJ with ties to the Certified Groovers circuit — the 'For The Groovers' SoundCloud output points toward deep, selector-minded house rather than peak-time tools.

mxm.note: Long-standing Certified Groovers resident known for extended deep/minimal sets — he's played 8-hour and longer slots for the collective, which gives this all-night billing real credibility.

pan pot.note: Berlin duo Tassilo Ippenberger and Thomas Benedix — founders of Second State and HUMAN labels; known for powerful, undulating techno with kinetic groove; two LPs and a string of influential releases since the mid-2000s. Extended sets are their signature move.

doostah.note: DJ known for dynamic sets spanning peak-time techno to deep and groovy — builds immersive journeys through long-format track selection; part of the LA/international underground techno circuit.

kitty logic.note: LA-based techno and trance DJ/producer, co-founder of TRANS*CENDENT (a trans-centered underground party series in LA) — driving, hypnotic techno with trance elements.

dea magna.note: LA-based producer, DJ and vocalist with classical music training — melodic house and techno, with live piano and vocals incorporated into sets. A distinct proposition at this hard-techno-leaning event.

merimell.note: Estonian DJ, the 'first lady of techno' in her home country — releases on Desolat, Unknown to the Unknown and Killekill; driving, dark industrial techno; also runs her 'Machine Nation' radio show and events series.

kayzo.note: LA-based (Houston-born) DJ/producer Hayden Capuozzo — hybrid hard bass, hardstyle, dubstep and metalcore-influenced electronic; Welcome Records founder, Insomniac Discovery Project winner. High production, aggressive sound.

amina jaguar.note: LA-based multilingual artist and DJ — 2x Grammy-considered; delivers afro house with a contagious, high-energy feel; regularly plays LA venues and outdoor events.

shanto.note: LA-based DJ and producer active in the afro house and global grooves space; RA profile, SoundCloud presence.

perstephanii.note: LA DJ/selector working the afro house circuit; co-billed with Shanto regularly on this organizer's events; limited verifiable bio beyond local presence.

young franco.note: Brisbane-born, Sydney-based producer/DJ (Joseph Da Rin de Barbera) — blends house, disco, hip-hop and funk into crowd-pleasing festival sets; associated with the Sweat It Out Australian collective; debut album 'It's Franky Baby' (2025). Four ARIA-Gold singles, 200M+ streams.

okayval.note: Colombian-American DJ/producer based in Jacksonville, FL — tech house and techno with viral social presence; Insomniac Records signee; describes her influences as Martin Garrix (big-room) filtered through Mau P and Dom Dolla (modern tech house). Rising festival circuit name.

kebra.note: Mexico City/Brazil-based DJ in the Guaracha/Tribal/Latin club circuit — part of Club Cielo's femme-forward international roster.

linapary.note: Colombia-based DJ in the Guaracha and Latin club sounds scene; recurring Club Cielo booking.

queenie us.note: US-based selector on the femme Latin club/Guaracha circuit; limited public footprint beyond the Club Cielo billing.

dinabn.note: Club Cielo founder and LA-based DJ — the party is her recurring series at El Cid, built around Guaracha, Bubbling, Juke and Latin electronic.

jacz.note: Supporting local DJ on the LA techno/acid circuit; limited public profile.

silvertone.note: LA-based selector on the underground techno/acid circuit; limited public profile.

xvirad.note: LA-based DJ on the local acid/techno circuit; limited public profile.

drakk.note: Santa Clara Valley-rooted industrial techno DJ/producer active since 2018 — support from Amelie Lens, Ihatemodels and Kobosil signals where he sits: aggressive, industrial-leaning European techno energy.

triptykh.note: Dallas-based hard techno/schranz DJ and producer — high-BPM, punishing peak-time sets in the early-2000s hard techno tradition; dedicated sound-pack and tutorial market has built him a cult following.

adam auburn.note: LA house DJ/producer with 15+ years at the wheel — Insomniac veteran (EDC, Nocturnal), runs his own Auburn Events production company and is one of the resident architects behind the Golden Hour Level 8 rooftop format.

gudfella.note: Philippines-born, LA-based house producer (Kyle Domingo) — polished melodic/vocal house, 113M+ streams, Beatport #1 with 'Morning Coffee'; Vintage Culture-influenced festival-house sound.

day thief.note: LA underground DJ on the Cirra collective circuit; no verifiable public profile — included per billing only.

faited.note: LA-based electronic DJ/producer; limited public footprint, recurring Cirra booking.

david le brun.note: LA-based DJ affiliated with the Cirra collective; limited public profile — could not verify a label or sound with confidence.

township rebellion.note: German duo — melodic and progressive techno built around deep, emotive soundscapes; labels include Rose Avenue, Hilomatik, Filth on Acid and Truesoul. Festival-circuit regulars (Fusion, Burning Man, EDC) and a staple at the progressive-techno end of the LA underground.

trou.note: Supporting LA-based DJ on the progressive/melodic techno circuit; limited public profile.

denyc.note: LA-based DJ on the local techno circuit; limited public profile, included per billing.

beltran.note: Brazilian DJ/producer (Juliano Beltran) — driving, percussive tech-house with Latin rhythm and low-end groove; Beatport #1 with 'Smack Yo' on Solid Grooves, viral YUMA/Coachella 2025 set, and support from Michael Bibi, Jamie Jones and Marco Carola. He's in Spotify rotation for a reason.

rosie love.note: East LA house and techno DJ — self-described 'technologist and performer in the LA underground world,' shaped by the '90s house and techno movement; Apt4B Radio affiliate and recurring fixture in the city's grassroots scene.

apt4b radio.note: LA collective staging intimate, intentional house/electronic mini-fests in lofts and local venues — no-phones policy, B2B format, roughly 20 active resident DJs.

mura masa.note: Guernsey-born Alexander Crossan — producer known for genre-blending alt-electronic (debut album Grammy-nominated), co-wrote PinkPantheress' global hit 'Boy's a Liar'. His DJ sets lean eclectic indie-dance rather than straight club fare.

adam spry.note: Bay Area multi-instrumentalist — folky indie pop/rock with atmospheric arrangements; shares stages with The Mother Hips, Rayland Baxter.

adam james.note: Coast-hopping indie singer-songwriter — slide guitars, reverb-doused melodies, California nostalgia. Regular Gold Diggers performer.

the pretty flowers.note: LA four-piece guitar-pop with Guided By Voices, Teenage Fanclub and Echo & the Bunnymen in their bloodline — new album 'Never Felt Bitter' out March 2026 on Forge Again Records.

markus schulz.note: German-American DJ/producer, Coldharbour Recordings founder — trance and progressive house, DJ Mag top 10 mainstay, best known for Global DJ Broadcast. Not the house/techno lane.

beau didier.note: Amsterdam-born DJ/producer (b. 1999) and co-founder of the Vulged underground platform — bass-heavy, vocal-driven hard-groove techno with releases on Molekül, Mutual Rytm and [SELECTED]; has played HÖR Berlin and Awakenings. European underground pedigree; this is his LA debut.

kyrxmi.note: CLOSER/THERMAL regular in the LA underground techno circuit; limited public footprint beyond local bookings.

ötak.note: THERMAL resident support act; LA-based techno DJ on the CLOSER circuit.

kana hishiya.note: Japanese-born, LA-based DJ and producer — house and techno spanning punchy basslines through minimal and broken beats; has played alongside Kenny Larkin and appeared on the MEOKO podcast; a genuine cornerstone of the LA underground community.

bilaliwood.note: LA-based Disconic resident — has supported DāM-FunK on the DTLA underground circuit; house and techno selector building a residency with this promoter.

john smith.note: LA-based underground house/techno selector; played the 'If You Know You Know' series with Binh (March 2026); limited wider public footprint beyond the local circuit.

charlotte de witte.note: Belgian techno titan (Rekids, her own KNTXT label) — relentlessly driving, hypnotic sets; one of the most consistently excellent live techno artists in the world. Tracked name.

amelie lens.note: Belgian techno DJ and producer, LENSKE label founder — high-energy, acid-flecked, peak-time techno with genuine emotional resonance. Tracked name.

anetha.note: Bordeaux-born French techno DJ/producer, Mama Told Ya label founder — driving post-club and industrial-flecked techno with feminist politics baked in; has played Berghain, fabric.

vtss.note: Warsaw-born Martyna Maja — high-speed industrial techno, EBM and hardcore-inflected; Repitch, Intrepid Skin, Discwoman resident. One of the sharpest fast-techno voices to emerge from Eastern Europe.

interplanetary criminal.note: Manchester producer Zachary Koa Bruce — co-founded ATW Records with Main Phase; 'B.O.T.A.' with Eliza Rose went UK #1 in 2022. Spearheading the current wave of speed garage and bassline into festival crossover.

luuk van dijk.note: Amsterdam DJ/producer (Dark Side of the Sun, Hot Creations, Solid Grooves) — fluid house-to-techno sets with genuine Awakenings / Circoloco pedigree; younger generation European club talent.

sammy virji.note: London DJ/producer — UK garage, bassline and bass house; 'If U Need It' pushed 50M+ streams; a driving force in bringing UKG to US festival audiences.

tiga.note: Montreal DJ and Turbo Recordings founder — introduced Gesaffelstein, Chromeo and Charlotte de Witte to the label; his wry electro and techno feel timeless. A scene elder who belongs on any credible festival lineup.

kohinoorgasm.note: Josephine Shetty — LA/Berkeley-based South Asian queer artist doing 'azaadi pop' — hypnotic synth beats with ethereal vocals and decolonial politics woven in; minimalist electronic production with raw emotional directness. A perfect fit for discostan's 15th anniversary.

tigerbalm.note: London-based DJ/producer Rose Robinson — global-inflected disco and Afro-house; debut album 'International Love Affair' on Ubiquity, second album 'Bubblegum Discos' (2026) out on Razor N Tape and 20/20 Vision. Deep tribal-to-disco selects with African and Latin American textures.

hayes bradley.note: LA DJ/producer and music supervisor — founded the vinyl-only label These Things Take Time while at Smart Bar Chicago; toured with Kaytranada; opened for James Blake, Flume and Kelly Lee Owens. Cinematic breakbeat-meets-ambient club sound with real selector depth.

teo amo.note: LA-based singer-producer performing a hybrid DJ/live set here — limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings; included on billing confidence.

boys noize.note: Berlin-born Alex Ridha — electro-techno and tech-house producer (Boysnoize Records), frequent collab partner of Skrillex and Daft Punk-adjacent; a festival mainstay who bridges underground credibility with mass-appeal energy.

gg 5.note: RA-listed artist tagged to this Townhouse Venice booking — insufficient public information to establish genre or scene; name is too generic to verify with confidence. Included on billing only.

the roamers.note: Insufficient public information to establish genre or background with confidence — an RA listing at the Redwood Bar and Grill in DTLA, which programs rock and blues. The venue gazetteer flags 'the redwood' as rock; included on that basis.

porter robinson.note: LA-based electronic producer and DJ — pioneered a strand of melodic, emotionally dense electronic music ('Worlds', 2014; 'Nurture', 2021) that sits somewhere between IDM, J-pop and rave. Strong Spotify-affinity signal in Ari's rotation.

louis the child.note: Chicago indie-electronic duo (Robby Hauldren and Freddy Kennett) — bright, vocal-forward melodic electronic with indie crossover appeal; Interscope-signed.

what so not.note: Australian producer Chris Emerson — melodic bass music and future bass; formerly half of Flume's early project. Insomniac circuit regular.

anton tumas.note: Long Beach DJ, founder of Subtract Music and the organizer of this festival — selects at the thoughtful, forward-thinking edge of house and techno; curator rather than crowd-pleaser.

doc martin.note: LA underground house and techno stalwart — San Francisco scene veteran, Sublevel label and events founder (25 years); 40 years behind the decks in 2026 with a fluid deep-house-to-tribal-bass range that remains genuinely authoritative.

lee burridge.note: British DJ/producer and All Day I Dream label founder — pioneered 'organic house' (melodic, dreamlike, Balearic-adjacent) starting with Brooklyn rooftop parties in 2007; the label's sound now defines an entire Beatport subgenre. Extended sets are his signature.

radio slave.note: Matt Edwards — Berlin-based British DJ/producer and Rekids label co-founder; collaborated with Nina Kraviz, Carl Craig, Robert Hood and Peggy Gou on the imprint. Firm, driving house and techno with real label-history weight.

mikey lion.note: San Diego DJ and co-founder of the Desert Hearts movement (began as a 200-person renegade Mojave gathering in 2012); Desert Hearts Records has become a community-anchored label for house and techno with tribal and psychedelic inflections.

justin martin.note: San Francisco DJ/producer and Dirtybird co-founder alongside Claude VonStroke — melodic, playful bass-house with emotional depth; 'Grapefruit' is still a touchstone. Launched his own label 'What To Do…' in 2020.

dj colette.note: Chicago house DJ, singer and Smart Bar resident — pioneered live vocal-over-DJ-set technique; her long-form performances blend soulful, full-range house with genuine showmanship. An under-celebrated veteran of the scene.

davi.note: Armenian-born, LA-based DJ/producer — releases on Crosstown Rebels, All Day I Dream and RADIANT; melodic house and techno with a driving dancefloor sensibility; played alongside Hernan Cattaneo and Nick Warren.

taylor shockley.note: LA-based selector and Information crew regular — vinyl-only house and disco, fixtures of the city's underground all-wax circuit.

luke mele.note: LA digger and Information affiliate — deep house and disco-leaning vinyl sets; low public footprint but recurs on LA's quality all-vinyl bills.

choíce.note: LA DJ on the Information circuit; couldn't verify a clear label home or scene origin beyond the local all-vinyl/house underground.

demuir.note: Toronto-born DJ/producer (Purveyor Underground, Hot Creations, Classic Music Company) — funky, jackin', soulful house; multiple Beatport #1 Jacking House producer years. Recurring Certified Groovers headliner in LA.

massimiliano pagliara.note: Puglia-born, Berlin-based selector with Berghain residencies and records on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton, and Permanent Vacation — Italo-flicker Balearic house meets deep disco; curates his own Funnuvojere Records label. German Record Critics' Award winner for 2022 album See You in Paradise.

james axon.note: LA-based Midnight Lovers crew selector; limited public bio but a regular on the crew's Balearic-leaning bills.

drama.note: Chicago duo of producer Na'el Shehade and vocalist Via Rosa — soulful R&B fused with dance-floor-adjacent electronics, spanning jazz, bossa nova and club textures; independent releases, debut album Dance Without Me (2020). Worth catching as the opener.

orlove.note: LA promoter/DJ (Orlovebynight) running a monthly indie-electronic night at The Moroccan — Daft Punk, French Touch, Soulwax, MGMT-territory. More of a theme-night concept than a headliner booking; fun if that's the mood.

gene on earth.note: California-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer who runs the Limousine Dream label — lush, cosmic, house-forward with 90s-nod bleeps and organ bass; also releases on Youandewan's Small Hours and Voigtmann's Subsequent. The 'Sound of Limo' comp he curated featured Roza Terenzi, Sweely, Dyed Soundorom.

these severed hands.note: IE-based 'pastel post-hardcore' band — melodic, textured, self-described post-hardcore; debut album act one (August 2025). Not the classic punk end, more emo-adjacent.

madison violet.note: Listed on this bill; couldn't verify a clear bio — likely a local LA indie act rather than the Toronto folk duo of the same name. Taking the DIY billing at face value.

black cat coalition.note: Collective or band on this bill; no verifiable public footprint found. Listed per the event detail.

lea occhi.note: Paris-born, Berlin-based DJ and co-founder of Spectrum (the LGBTQIA+ collective at La Station Gare des Mines) — groove-led rhythms over swinging deep techno; played Berghain, Tresor, Bassiani. West coast debut per the billing.

softchaos.note: Berlin-based DJ, member of the Toro art collective — blends techno, Baltimore club, drum & bass and breaks; queer dancefloor-liberationist in the mold of the Gegen/Panorama Bar underground.

banoffee.note: Melbourne-born musician Martha Brown — mutant pop and electronic, somewhere between alt-R&B and club music (Dot Dash, Two Bright Lakes); known for albums Look at Us Now Dad and Tear Tracks. The DJ context here is unusual for her; she's more a vocalist/producer than a selector.

shane thomas.note: LA electronic DJ on the local underground circuit; limited verifiable public bio.

rob aquino.note: LA DJ, local circuit; couldn't verify a clear scene affiliation or label home beyond the local electronic underground.

heidi lawden.note: LA DJ on the queer underground circuit; recurring on Extra Sensory bills. Limited public bio outside local event listings.

michelle manetti.note: LA-based DJ and Extra Sensory affiliate; listed as part of the lineup; no verifiable label or wider scene footprint found.

goldcap.note: LA DJ/producer Berge Sahakian — organic/melodic house with world-music textures; releases on Sol Selectas and Pipe & Pochet; inspired by Lee Burridge and Dixon. Known for long, immersive open-to-close sets at intimate underground events.

shakolin.note: Ukrainian selector, long-time Closer Kyiv resident now based in Berlin — co-runs Delirious, the vinyl-only label and Panorama Bar party series with partner Karine. Deep digger whose debut EP Destination (Unknown) came out on his own Delirious imprint.

slip.note: Information crew selector; appears on multiple all-vinyl bills in LA. Couldn't verify a wider label affiliation or scene origin beyond the local underground.

renato cohen.note: São Paulo techno pioneer (b. 1974) — Carl Cox's Intec label, Technasia remixes, Chris Liebing's CLR; multiple Brazilian producer-of-the-year awards. His Intec track 'Pontapé' is a catalog marker. LA debut was slated here.
